🚧 We’re Hiring: PMO Manager \| Building Construction 🚧
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced PMO Manager to join our growing construction team in the UAE. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in project management, contract administration, cost control, authority coordination, and construction planning for high\-rise and building construction projects.
 



  





 📍 Location: UAE
 



 🕒 Job Type: Full\-time
 



 💰 Salary: AED 30,000 per month
 



  





 🔹 Key Responsibilities:
 



 • Lead and manage PMO operations across multiple building construction projects
 



 • Formalize, review, and manage construction contracts and project documentation
 



 • Review and approve project specifications, contract terms, and technical requirements
 



 • Prepare and review BOQs, project budgets, and cost estimates
 



 • Identify and resolve building design and project identity gaps during planning and execution stages
 



 • Coordinate and manage communication with government authorities, consultants, and stakeholders
 



 • Monitor project timelines, milestones, deliverables, and construction schedules
 



 • Prepare project execution plans and ensure timely project delivery
 



 • Monitor cost\-to\-complete analysis, project cash flow, and financial performance
 



 • Implement effective cost control measures and risk management strategies
 



 • Ensure compliance with quality standards, regulations, and authority requirements
 



 • Coordinate with project managers, consultants, procurement, and engineering teams for smooth project execution
 



 • Generate project progress reports and provide strategic recommendations to management
 



  





 🔹 Requirements:
 



 • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related field
 



 • Proven experience as PMO Manager in building construction projects within the UAE
 



 • Strong knowledge of contracts, BOQ preparation, cost control, and project planning
 



 • Experience dealing with consultants, authorities, and project stakeholders
 



 • Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
 



 • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively
 



 • PMP certification is an advantage
 



  





  





 📩 Apply Now: Career@abualnaga.com

 Legal, health and safety requirements

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview/Purpose**
 The Lead – Business Operations, Global Oncology will play a critical role in driving launch excellence and early access strategies across small to mid\-sized markets where Glenmark Oncology does not have dedicated in\-country oncology leadership.
   

  

 This role will act as a strategic and operational partner to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology, ensuring organizational readiness, optimal resource allocation, and execution of commercial infrastructure (including CRM and analytics). The incumbent will also serve as support to the Global Head in governance, decision\-making, and cross\-functional alignment.
   

  

**Overall Job Responsibilities**
* Launch Excellence \& Early Access Strategy
* Lead the development and execution of launch strategies for oncology assets in small\-to\-mid\-sized markets.
* Design scalable, repeatable “go\-to\-market” models tailored for distributor\-led or hybrid markets.
* Drive early access strategies including:
* Named Patient Programs (NPPs)
* Compassionate use programs
* Managed access agreements
* Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Supply teams to ensure timely market entry.
* Develop launch readiness frameworks, KPIs, and tracking mechanisms.
* Market Development (Non\-Core / White Space Markets)
* Identify, prioritize, and assess new market opportunities where Glenmark lacks oncology presence.
* Build market entry playbooks (partner vs. direct vs. hybrid models).
* Support distributor selection, onboarding, and performance management.
* Ensure alignment of local execution with global brand strategy.
* Commercial Operations \& Infrastructure
* Lead implementation and optimization of CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce Health Cloud).
* Establish standardized commercial processes, reporting dashboards, and performance tracking.
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making through analytics and insights generation.
* Oversee commercial excellence initiatives including:
* Sales force effectiveness (where applicable)
* Omnichannel engagement frameworks
* Digital enablement tools
* Organizational Readiness \& Capability Building
* Partner with the Head of Global Commercial Oncology to ensure readiness for upcoming launches.
* Define target operating models for new markets.
* Support hiring strategy, role design, and capability frameworks (especially for distributor markets).
* Develop training frameworks and onboarding programs for new teams/partners.
* Resource Allocation \& Financial Planning
* Lead commercial budgeting and resource allocation across emerging markets.
* Optimize deployment of financial and human resources based on market potential and strategic priority.
* Track ROI on launch investments and commercial initiatives.
* Support long\-range planning (LRP) and annual operating plans (AOP).
* Strategic Planning \& Governance
* Act as a strategic advisor and deputy to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology.
* Support development of global oncology commercial strategy.
* Lead cross\-functional governance forums and business reviews.
* Drive alignment across global, regional, and local stakeholders.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Serve as a central coordination point across: Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance
* Ensure integrated execution of launch and commercialization plans.
* Competitive Intelligence \& Market Insights
* Monitor competitive landscape across oncology markets.
* Benchmark best practices from leading oncology players (MNCs).
* Translate insights into actionable strategies for Glenmark.
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* Ensure all commercial activities adhere to global compliance standards and local regulations.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to distributor\-led markets and early access programs.
* Key Deliverables / Success Metrics
* Successful launch of oncology assets in priority emerging markets.
* Time\-to\-market reduction in non\-core geographies.
* CRM implementation effectiveness and adoption rates.
* Achievement of early access program targets.
* Budget adherence and ROI optimization.
* Distributor performance and market expansion outcomes.


**Key Relationships/Stakeholders**
**External**
* Oncology KOLs and treatment centers
* Oncology societies and networks
* Strategic partners and service providers


**Internal (other Than Direct Reports)**
* Regional/Country Commercial Leadership Teams
* Global Oncology Franchise \& Brand Teams
* Country Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Finance, and Supply Chain


**Desired Experience And Knowledge**
**Educational**
* MBA or master’s degree in business, Life Sciences, or related field preferred


**Experience**
* 12–15\+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech experience, with a strong focus on innovative oncology.
* Proven track record in global or regional commercial roles
* Experience in launch excellence, emerging markets, or distributor\-led markets.
* Experience operating in complex, fast\-evolving oncology markets.
* Prior country\-level or franchise leadership experience is strongly preferred.


**Knowledge And Skills (Functional And Technical)**
* Strong understanding of oncology market access and early access pathways.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce).
* Ability to work in cross functional groups and teams with a complex matrix organization.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and build new market structures
* Exceptional stakeholder management, influence, and communication skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership
* High ethical standards with uncompromising compliance orientation.

The role holder leads the client relationship through a team of (Senior) Account Managers and Legal Assistants to deliver pro\-active, exceptional service to client companies. The role holder is accountable to generate revenue based on value\-charging by coordinating legal, administrative and corporate activities for companies. The role holder also promotes (new) products and services, and actively participates in growing the business from existing clients as well as identifying prospective clients through client referrals. As Director of various Amicorp entities and client companies, the role holder supports the management in realizing the projected turnover and returns based on the short and long term strategy of Amicorp.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Responsible for managing the portfolios of clients and guide them on international structuring. Work directly with our clients in analyzing and interpreting regulations, procedures, documents relating to our clients’ legal and fiscal opportunities
* Setting up and managing corporate and private legal structures and actively participating in growing and marketing our business. Administering a portfolio of companies, limited partnerships and trusts in accordance with applicable legislation
* Ultimately responsible for the quality of the client files. Assure that companies are capitalized, and that the management agreements are available in the clients’ files.
* Manage companies and ensure that all information in the client files is correct and up\-to\-date
* Monitor, manage, verify and approve the preparation of minutes of meetings of boards of directors or managers and proxies. Coordinate issues concerning taxes, administration, and banking of client companies with the Client Accounting Department
* Fully understand the client’s activities and make sure that any action taken is consistent with the company’s activities and purpose within the legal and economic framework for the company. Assure that all correspondence is signed in conformity with the signatory authority list
* Ensure adherence to and ongoing analysis of Amicorp’s 4\-Pillar approach in particular compliance, legal and corporate services, transaction monitoring and tax and transparency. \- Anticipate and manage the impact of any emerging regulatory, taxation or legal changes and ensure compliance related risk addressed on behalf of the client.
* Achieve financial chargeability targets, ensure effective monitoring of transactions, handle pricing, invoicing and collection of outstanding fees for the portfolio of clients.
* Promote Amicorp in specialized round tables and prepare articles for publishing in internal and external publications
* Work closely with the Local Management Team, Client Acceptance Committee (“CAC”) and Compliance to find commercial solutions to onboarding and on\-going client administration/service as appointed member of the CAC



  





  





 Candidate Profile :

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies that power mobility platforms. Its flagship Drive\-to\-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.
   

  

 Moove’s growth has been fuelled by its global Uber partnership and support of leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, MUFG, and many others. With operations now spanning 19 cities across 6 continents \- Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and the Middle East \- Moove continues to expand its offerings through strategic acquisitions and partnerships with industry leaders, including Waymo and Uber. Moove is transforming mobility to make it safer, more efficient and accessible to all, while providing economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Performance \& Strategy at Moove is responsible for driving business performance, planning discipline, and execution across markets. This role owns the end\-to\-end performance management cycle, including running business reviews, leading planning processes, and identifying and driving resolution of key performance issues in partnership with market and functional leaders. In parallel, you will act as a strategic partner to local teams, supporting critical decisions on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion, while aligning cross\-functional stakeholders. The role also leads key strategic initiatives, including new market launches, new business lines (e.g. AV), and other growth opportunities, ensuring disciplined execution from planning through implementation.
   

  

**This role is a "temp role" of 6 months.**
**What You’ll Be Doing**
 As Moove scales across markets, this role ensures consistent delivery across four core areas: business performance, project management across centrally driven initiatives, expansion, and cross\-functional execution.
   

  

 Critical outcomes (6–12 months)
   

  

* Establish a consistent performance management cadence across markets (SteerCos, dashboards, planning cycles)
* Identify and address key drivers of underperformance, improving profitability and operational efficiency
* Deliver high\-impact strategic initiatives (e.g., market launches, pricing improvements, new revenue streams)


 Scope of responsibilities \& impact areas
   

  

* Performance Management: Own weekly and monthly business reviews, track key metrics, and lead deep dives to understand performance drivers and gaps
* Strategic Planning: Lead annual budgeting, OKRs, and quarterly planning processes, ensuring alignment between company goals and market execution
* Market Support: Provide hands\-on support to local teams on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion decisions through structured analysis
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Finance, Legal, Tech, and Operations to resolve issues and ensure delivery of key priorities
* Data \& Reporting: Partner with Data/BI teams to build and maintain accurate, automated dashboards, ensuring a single source of truth and reducing manual reporting
* Central Program Management: Track and manage key strategic commitments, ensuring accountability and timely execution across teams
* Expansion \& Growth: Support and lead new market launches, new categories, and other strategic initiatives from evaluation through implementation


**What You Will Need For This Position**
 Experience:
   

  

* 10\-12\+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles in high\-growth environments
* Strong track record of driving business performance and solving complex operational problems
* Experience working across multiple markets or regions is preferred


 Education \& Skills:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and financial modeling
* Familiarity with BI tools
* Solid understanding of unit economics, cost structures, and performance drivers


 Behavioural \& Leadership Traits:
   

  

* Structured problem\-solver with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage stakeholders and influence decisions across teams
* Clear and effective communicator, including with senior leadership
* High ownership and ability to operate in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments
* Focus on execution and delivering measurable outcomes


**Key Metrics**
**I** 
 mprovement in core business metrics such as revenue growth, utilization, contribution margin, and cashflow
   

  

* Effectiveness of performance management processes (e.g., quality and consistency of reviews, dashboard adoption)
* Successful delivery of strategic initiatives, including market launches and new revenue streams


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CEO Moove, and closely working with our Central OperationsTeam.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

data.jd_text:
**Remobile Group is looking for a Group Operations Manager to help oversee and control daily operations across our growing businesses and teams.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who is highly organised, structured, proactive, and experienced in e\-commerce operations. The right person will work closely with the CEO and team members across different locations to make sure tasks are clearly assigned, deadlines are followed, communication stays organised, and operational issues are reported before they become bigger problems.
 



  





 This is not only an admin role. We are looking for someone who can bring structure, accountability, and follow\-up across multiple teams, offices, and online business operations.
 



  





 About Remobile Group
 



 Remobile Group operates multiple businesses in the mobile phone and consumer electronics industry, including e\-commerce operations, Shopify stores, refurbishment, procurement, sales, marketing, and international teams.
 



  





 The Group Operations Manager will help create one clear operating structure across the company so that all important tasks, projects, and responsibilities are properly tracked and followed up.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 You will be responsible for keeping control of daily tasks and operational follow\-up across Remobile Group. You will make sure tasks are created correctly in ClickUp or Notion, assigned to the right person, given clear deadlines, and followed up until completion.
 



  





 You will also monitor team communication through Slack, ensure important discussions are converted into clear tasks, and keep the CEO updated on progress, delays, bottlenecks, and issues that require attention.
 



  





 The role includes coordinating with employees across different departments and locations, including Pakistan, Dubai, and European operations, while being based hybrid in the Netherlands, Germany, or Poland.
 



  





 You will help prepare daily and weekly operational updates, track overdue tasks, follow up with team members, support meeting preparation, take meeting notes, and make sure every meeting ends with clear action points.
 



  





 You will also support e\-commerce operations by helping teams stay organised around Shopify\-related tasks, product updates, marketing follow\-ups, customer experience issues, stock/pricing coordination, reporting, and general online business execution.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone with 2–3 years of experience in e\-commerce operations, operations coordination, project coordination, or business operations.
 



  





 You should have practical experience using ClickUp or Notion for task management and be comfortable using Slack for team communication. You must be able to create structure, follow up professionally, and keep teams accountable without creating unnecessary pressure or confusion.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is organised, reliable, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working directly with senior management. You should be able to understand priorities, follow up on deadlines, identify delays, and clearly report what is completed, what is pending, and what needs CEO attention.**

**Job Title:** 
 IT Engineer
 



**Department:** 
 Information Technology
 



**Reports To:** 
 Head of PMO
 







**Job Purpose:** 




 As an IT Engineer, you will design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot IT systems, networks, and infrastructure across all business units within the Group.
 



  





 You will ensure the functionality, security, and efficiency of the organization’s technology infrastructure, supporting smooth business operations and resolving technical issues related to systems, networks, cloud environments, and cybersecurity.
 







  





**Responsibilities:** 




**1\. IT Infrastructure \& System Administration** 



* Manage and maintain enterprise hardware, software, servers, and network infrastructure.
* Perform installation, configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle management of IT systems.
* Support virtualization platforms, server environments, and enterprise applications to maintain high system availability.
* Monitor infrastructure performance, system health, and network reliability.



  





**2\. Cloud \& Hybrid Environment Management** 



* Administer and support cloud\-based productivity and collaboration platforms within hybrid IT environments.
* Assist in cloud integration, infrastructure modernization, and deployment of new technologies.
* Support resource provisioning, cloud migrations, and operational scalability initiatives.



  





**3\. IT Security \& Compliance** 



* Implement IT security policies, access controls, and operational procedures to safeguard organizational infrastructure and business data.
* Manage firewall configurations, VPN access, endpoint protection, and email security solutions.
* Ensure adherence to cybersecurity best practices and support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture.



  





**4\. System Maintenance \& Operational Support** 



* Perform regular system maintenance, updates, patch management, and preventive troubleshooting.
* Manage backup operations, disaster recovery procedures, and business continuity measures.
* Provide technical support to users by resolving hardware, software, connectivity, and application\-related issues efficiently.



  





**5\. Network \& Connectivity Management** 



* Manage network infrastructure components including connectivity, wireless solutions, remote access, and communication systems.
* Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity or infrastructure\-related issues.
* Support network security and ensure stable and secure communication environments.



  





**6\. Automation \& Digital Workplace Solutions** 



* Utilize AI\-powered productivity and automation tools to improve operational workflows and administrative efficiency.
* Support digital workplace and knowledge management platforms to enhance collaboration and communication.
* Assist in workflow optimization and infrastructure process improvements.



  





**7\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Vendor Coordination** 



* Collaborate with internal teams to integrate new technologies and systems into the existing infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for procurement, maintenance, and project implementation.
* Support office infrastructure setup, IT asset deployment, and employee onboarding/offboarding processes.



  





**8\. Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and infrastructure records.
* Document IT procedures, configurations, and support processes to maintain operational knowledge.
* Prepare performance reports and provide recommendations for infrastructure improvements.







  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in IT support, system administration, network administration, or a similar role.
* Professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Security\+, or Microsoft Azure Fundamentals are preferred.
* Experience working with enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, and network management environments is highly preferred.







  





**Technical Skills:** 



* Proficiency in Windows, Linux, and Mac operating systems.
* Strong knowledge of networking protocols including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and related technologies.
* Experience with server administration, virtualization technologies, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of firewalls, VPNs, endpoint protection, and cybersecurity practices.
* Experience in backup management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
* Understanding of automation tools, PowerShell scripting, and workflow optimization.







  





**Core Competencies:** 



* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently.
* Proactive approach to infrastructure optimization and operational improvement.
* Strong collaboration and cross\-functional communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Continuous learning mindset with adaptability to emerging technologies and IT innovations.

The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.

 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface

* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.

 Education \& Certifications

 Experience

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 At Dyson, we’re driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation—pushing boundaries in engineering, AI, and robotics. Our new Data Intelligence team sits at the heart of this mission: shaping Dyson’s future through data. Here, we blend creativity, precision, and audacity to power intelligent products. We craft data strategies and pipelines that fuel the next generation of connected devices.
   

  

 You’ll work alongside brilliant minds from Dyson global engineering team and external software/hardware partners in an environment built for exploration, discovery, delivery and impact.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Lead Data Intelligence Project Manager, you ensure that every project has the resources it needs to take off, you'll orchestrate data operations that power product development across Dyson’s global teams. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Act as the primary liaison between our external project teams and our internal technical departments (Data Curation and MLOps). You will own the "data logistics" for the entire project lifecycle—from initial storage setup to final delivery of high\-quality training sets.
* You will be the strategic lead for our labelling workforce, managing the balance between our in\-house contractors and 3rd party service providers to ensure we never hit a capacity bottleneck.
* Overseeing data storage setup and maintenance to guarantee security, accessibility, and compliance.
* Maintaining rigorous documentation and workflows that ensure project transparency and repeatability.
* Supporting cross\-functional communication between data teams, contractors, and engineering partners.


**About you**
* 8\+ years in Project or Program Management, with at least 2 years specifically in AI/ML Data Operations or Data Management. You’ve delivered complex projects on time and within scope—often in fast\-changing settings.
* Demonstrated success in managing 3rd party vendors or service providers, including contract negotiation, quality assurance, issue resolution, and ongoing relationship management.
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Knowledge: Strong understanding of how data flows from collection → cleaning → labeling → training → deployment.
* Tooling Familiarity: Experience with labeling platforms (Labelbox, CVAT, Label Studio) and project management tools (Jira, Asana, or Airtable).
* Data Literacy: Basic understanding of data storage architectures (S3, SQL, Snowflake) and data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
* Communication: Exceptional "translation" skills—the ability to explain technical MLOps constraints to business stakeholders and vice versa.
* A solid understanding of modern data storage solutions (cloud, on\-premises, hybrid), including principles of data security, privacy, access control, and regulatory compliance.
* Able to translate complex technical requirements into clear actions for both technical and non\-technical audiences. You’re adept at influencing and building consensus.
* Confident interfacing with cross\-functional teams—coordinating with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and external stakeholders to deliver smooth handovers and alignment.
* Well\-versed in project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall). Known for driving continuous improvement, clear documentation, and repeatable processes.
* Thorough, highly organized, and relentless in troubleshooting issues and removing blockers before they impact delivery.
* Proactive, accountable, and comfortable juggling competing priorities. You always keep end goals in focus and balance urgency with quality.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or Information Technology); higher degree or PMP/Prince2 certification is a plus.


 Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

**Overview**
 We are looking for an Experience Operations Lead to take ownership of how experience design is delivered across projects.
   

  

 This role focuses on turning strong experience direction into high quality, well structured delivery. You will ensure that ideas hold up through the realities of timelines, tools, team dynamics, and technical constraints, without losing clarity or intent.
   

  

 You will define how delivery works, support teams in executing it, and ensure a consistent standard across all work.
   

  

**The role**
 You are responsible for making sure that experience design is delivered properly, consistently, and at a high level of quality.
   

  

 You work from a clear experience direction and help shape how it is delivered in practice. You are not solely responsible for defining the vision, but you contribute to how it evolves through real delivery.
   

  

 You create clarity where there is complexity and structure where there is ambiguity. You care about craft and about the systems that allow that craft to scale.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Delivery and execution**
* Own the delivery of experience design work across projects and clients
* Translate experience direction into clear and actionable plans
* Ensure UX, UI, motion, and content outputs are consistent and high quality
* Make decisions to maintain quality under real constraints
* Protect the integrity of the experience through handover to engineering


**Delivery strategy and standards**
* Define how experience design is delivered across projects and programs
* Establish clear standards for workflows, documentation, and quality
* Work closely with leadership to shape delivery approaches
* Balance quality, speed, and feasibility in day to day work


**Design operations and workflow**
* Establish scalable ways of working across teams and projects
* Improve collaboration between design, product, and engineering
* Define and apply documentation standards that teams can follow
* Support delivery across geographies and with external partners
* Create clarity in how work moves from concept to execution


**Team support and production**
* Support designers in their day to day work
* Manage resourcing, timelines, and coordination
* Remove blockers so teams can focus on design
* Help maintain consistency and quality across the team


**AI and operational improvement**
* Explore how AI and tools can improve workflows and delivery
* Identify opportunities to automate and simplify work
* Support the team in adopting new tools in a practical way
* Continuously improve how the team works


**How You Work With Others**
 You work from clear experience direction while collaborating closely with design, product, and engineering teams.
   

  

 You are the point of authority for experience delivery within projects. You guide teams and stakeholders toward decisions that support both quality and feasibility.
   

  

 You work closely with the Head of Experience and other leads, contributing to how the department evolves while owning delivery within your scope.
   

  

**Experience**
**What we are looking for**
* 8 or more years in digital design, product, or experience delivery
* Strong hands on background across UX and UI
* Experience leading delivery or improving design operations
* Comfortable working with cross functional teams and clients


**Core Skills**
* Strong understanding of UX and UI in real delivery environments
* Clear sense of quality and attention to detail
* Ability to structure work and create clarity in complex situations
* Confident working with tools, documentation, and workflows

* Experience with design systems and scalable approaches

 Once you apply, our Recruitment team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com. We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let us know.
   

  

**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people \- and that starts with our own teams.  Fime is a globally recognised international player providing deep expertise across digital payments, mobility services, and digital identity. We work with leading organisations worldwide to solve complex challenges, identify emerging opportunities, and future\-proof their strategies.
 



  





 Our team of 900\+ experts operates in over 20 locations around the globe, delivering solutions that support millions of transactions every day, across global markets. What sets us apart is our values: we are curious, creative, and highly collaborative, with a strong commitment to integrity \- we do the right thing for our clients, our people, and our shareholders.
 



  





 At Fime, the work is varied and intellectually stimulating. No two days are the same, and you will be surrounded by smart, engaged colleagues who value learning and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Move. Pay. Trust.** 




**Where identity, money, and movement connect.** 




  





**MISSION** 




 As a Technical Project Manager, Payments your mission is to successfully plan, execute, and deliver projects while ensuring adherence to scope, timeline, budget, and quality standards. You will lead project teams, manage resources and risks, and maintain effective communication with stakeholders (after identifying internal \& external stakeholders). By applying Fime – Consult Hyperion project management framework (PM@CHyp) principles, you will oversee project execution, monitor progress, and address deviations promptly. Your goal is to achieve the project objectives, optimize resource utilization, and foster a positive team dynamic. Throughout the project lifecycle, you will proactively manage risks, ensure stakeholder engagement, and implement quality control measures. Ultimately, your mission is to drive the project successfully, promote continuous improvement, and deliver valuable outcomes that meet stakeholder expectations.
 



  





 Projects scope includes delivering consultancy services and certification test platforms to the Payment, Smart Mobility and Digital Identity ecosystems stakeholders. Main customers are International and Domestic Payment Schemes, Payment Service Providers, Financial Institutions, Transport Authorities, Digital Identity Service Provider.
 



  





**ACTIVITIES** 



* **Project Planning** 
 : Collaborate with stakeholders to define project goals, objectives, scope, and deliverables. Develop a comprehensive project plan, including task breakdown, timeline, resource allocation, and risk management strategies.
* **Team Management** 
 : Assemble and lead project teams, assign activities, provide guidance, and foster collaboration. Ensure effective communication, resolve conflicts, and motivate team members to achieve project objectives.
* **Project Execution** 
 : Oversee the execution of project activities, ensuring that tasks are completed as per the defined plan. Monitor progress, track milestones, and manage any deviations or issues that arise during project implementation.
* **Scope and Change Management** 
 : Manage project scope by defining and controlling project boundaries. Evaluate change requests, assess their impact, and implement changes while maintaining project objectives and minimizing scope creep.
* **Stakeholder Management** 
 : Engage with project stakeholders, including clients, sponsors, and team members. Maintain regular communication, manage expectations, and address stakeholder needs and concerns throughout the project lifecycle.
* **Risk Management** 
 : Identify, assess, and manage project risks. Develop risk mitigation and contingency plans to minimize the impact of potential risks on project outcomes. Monitor risks and take proactive measures to address them.
* **Quality Assurance** 
 : Establish quality control processes to ensure that project deliverables meet defined standards and stakeholder expectations. Conduct regular reviews, inspections, and testing to maintain high\-quality outcomes.
* **Resource Management** 
 : Optimize resource allocation to ensure efficient utilization of project resources, including personnel, equipment, and materials. Monitor resource availability, adjust as needed, and manage dependencies.
* **Communication and Reporting** 
 : Maintain effective communication channels with stakeholders, providing regular project updates, progress reports, and key milestone achievements. Foster transparent and timely communication to ensure project transparency.
* **Project Closure:** 
 Facilitate proper project closure by conducting post\-project evaluations, capturing lessons learned, and documenting project outcomes. Ensure the orderly handover of deliverables and transition of project responsibilities.



  





**JOB EXPERIENCE** 



* At least 7 years’ experience in project management roles, with proven track record of managing complex projects or portfolios

**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**

 At Dubai Holding, we're committed to nurturing the success and well\-being of our colleagues. data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

Project Director – High Rise Residential Construction \| Mumbai
 



 We are currently working on a confidential leadership mandate with one of India’s leading real estate developers for a landmark luxury high\-rise residential development in Mumbai. Mandatory experience in delivering 300m\+ residential tower projects is required for this role. Candidates must have prior experience leading execution of 80\+ floor high\-rise residential developments from commencement through completion.
 



 The organization is looking to appoint an experienced Project Director to lead the complete end\-to\-end execution of a large\-scale iconic residential tower project from commencement through final delivery.
 



 This role requires a seasoned construction leader with strong technical expertise, leadership capability, and a proven track record in delivering complex high\-rise developments globally or within India.
 



 Job Purpose:
 



 The Project Director will lead the overall execution strategy, planning, design coordination, construction management, budgeting, contracts, procurement, stakeholder management, quality control, safety, and final delivery of the project. The role demands close coordination across multidisciplinary teams and leadership stakeholders while ensuring delivery within timelines, quality standards, and commercial objectives.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 



 • Define the overall project strategy, execution roadmap, and construction schedules in coordination with leadership and consultants
 



 • Lead multidisciplinary teams across design, engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, contracts, and quality functions
 



 • Oversee advanced engineering coordination between structural, MEP, façade, interiors, and vertical transportation consultants
 



 • Drive value engineering, constructability reviews, and technical optimization during design development stages
 



 • Lead construction execution for high\-rise structures including deep foundations, core \& shell systems, façade systems, luxury interiors, and premium finishing packages
 



 • Ensure strict compliance with project timelines, quality benchmarks, EHS standards, statutory regulations, and international construction standards
 



 • Monitor project progress through regular reviews, reporting systems, and construction tracking mechanisms
 



 • Manage project budgets, cashflows, cost controls, escalations, and commercial performance
 



 • Oversee tendering, bid evaluations, procurement strategy, contractor management, claims management, and contract administration for major packages including civil, MEP, façade, and interiors
 



 • Work closely with internal leadership teams, consultants, architects, PMCs, contractors, sales teams, and regulatory authorities
 



 • Identify project risks proactively and implement mitigation strategies across technical, commercial, and operational aspects
 



 • Build and lead high\-performing project management teams while driving accountability and execution excellence
 



 • Implement modern construction technologies, BIM\-enabled coordination, digital monitoring tools, and international best practices
 



 Experience Requirements:
 



 • Graduate in Civil Engineering is mandatory; M.Tech / MBA in Project Management preferred
 



 • 20–25\+ years of experience in large\-scale building construction projects
 



 • Mandatory experience delivering 300m\+ residential tower developments
 



 • Must have led execution of 80\+ floor high\-rise residential or mixed\-use projects from start to completion
 



 • Strong expertise in structural systems, façade engineering, MEP coordination, vertical transportation systems, and premium residential construction
 



 • Prior GCC / international high\-rise construction exposure will be considered an advantage
 



 • Experience working with reputed developers, PMCs, EPC firms, or international contracting organizations preferred
 



 • Strong understanding of modern construction technologies, BIM systems, project controls, cost management, safety systems, and stakeholder management required
 



 Key Skills \& Competencies:
 



 • Strategic project planning and execution
 



 • Leadership and multidisciplinary team management
 



 • Technical coordination and construction management
 



 • Contractual and commercial management
 



 • Risk mitigation and quality systems implementation
 



 • Stakeholder engagement and decision\-making capability
 



 • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
 



 • Ability to manage large\-scale complex developments under demanding timelines
 



 This is a rare opportunity to lead one of India’s most ambitious skyline\-defining residential developments currently under execution.
 



 For a confidential discussion, please connect directly:
 



 📩 kara.sharma@mrgglobal.com
 



 📞 \+91 8446117482

Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Program Manager for its AMET operations team. The candidate should enjoy getting their hands dirty, and looking around the corners for solutions with the aim of optimization of OTR operations in Amazon’s last mile delivery stations.
   

  

 As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) program manager, you will be the subject matter expert for UTR and OTR operations driving capacity enhancements and utilization improvements in both.
   

  

 You will be a subject matter expert on routing and sortation operations and accountable for RUBL60 and sort grid utilization metrics. You should be able to think big to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes.
   

  

 This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, shipper experience and operator experience; monitor metrics, determine, then drive any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgement and decision\-making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products/programs with little information. He / She will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, business, and operations leaders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As UTR and OTR capacity SME, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Driving (accountable) RUBL60 and Sort Grid utilization metrics across MEATR region.
* Invent solutions to solve complex business problems.
* Provide corresponding tools to support Central Ops.
* Build mechanisms and monitor RUBL60 and Bag utilization metrics on a daily basis. Identify root causes and corrective/preventive actions for misses.
* Discuss trends and unusual behaviors of the RUBL60 and bag utilization metric.
* Provide sustainable solutions and effective guidance across the organization.
* Leverage route planning metrics to define, characterize areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with Tech/Science teams to enhance route planning systems.
* Aim to produce routes that are efficient and maximize the time utilization without impacting drivers' workload.
* Influence Route Planning teams to build models that generate fair, sustainable, and efficient delivery routes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

data.jd_text:
Join Our Team at Eaton: Empowering Tomorrow, Today!
   

  

 Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for
 **Global Program engineer Manager \- Multi‑Tenant Data Centers (MTDC).** 
 The role is a globally focused leadership role within the Post‑Order CoE, accountable for driving consistent execution, operational alignment, and customer outcomes across Eaton’s largest MTDC customers. This role ensures that Eaton delivers as One Eaton for multi\-tenant customers by coordinating post‑order activities across regions, business units, and functions. The position is based in Dubai and operates with global responsibility across EMEA, Americas, and APAC.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Strategic Account Operations Leadership**
* Act as the global post‑order CoE operational lead for assigned MTDC strategic accounts.
* Ensure Eaton delivers as One Global Organization, with consistent execution models and customer experience worldwide
* Serve as the primary operations interface between Eaton and MTDC customers following contract award.
* Ensure alignment between commercial commitments and execution capabilities across regions.


**Global Execution Governance**
* Drive adoption of standardized global execution models, operating rhythms, and governance frameworks for MTDC customers.
* Lead cross‑regional operating reviews focused on schedule, quality, risk, cost, and customer satisfaction.
* Establish performance visibility through dashboards, metrics, and structured reporting.


**Risk Management \& Issue Resolution**
* Proactively identify delivery, capacity, quality, and schedule risks across global deployments.
* Lead structured mitigation plans and escalations in partnership with regional and functional leaders.
* Ensure rapid issue resolution while maintaining strong customer confidence and trust.


**Cross** 
**‑** 
**Functional Coordination**
* Coordinate execution across Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Project Management, Quality, Services, and regional delivery teams.
* Influence outcomes in a highly matrixed global environment without direct line authority.
* Support alignment between Global Account Management, regional sales teams, and post‑order execution.


**Continuous Improvement \& Scalability**
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives to enhance execution efficiency, predictability, and scalability for MTDC programs.
* Capture lessons learned and deployed best practices across regions and accounts.
* Support digitalization and process maturity initiatives aligned with Eaton Business System (EBS) principles.

* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or structured continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience with agile, hybrid, or ProLaunch‑style methodologies.


**Why Join Eaton**

* Your aspirations matter – Eaton actively supports internal mobility and promotes from within whenever possible.
* Your growth matters – We invest in long‑term development through continuous learning, upskilling, and global programs via Eaton University.

* Your wellbeing matters – Health, safety, and wellness are a priority. At Eaton, wellbeing goes beyond programs, empowering employees with the tools and environment to thrive.


**Living And Working In Dubai**
 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Department \| Psychology**
**American University of Sharjah**
 The Department of Psychology in the College of Arts and Sciences at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applications for the position of Head of Department. The department seeks a collaborative and visionary leader with a record of excellence in teaching, research and service, and a strong commitment to student success and faculty development.
   

  

**About The Department**
 The department offers a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and contributes significantly to the university’s general education curriculum. Faculty members are engaged in diverse areas of research, including mental health and well\-being; cognitive psychology and psycholinguistics; organizational psychology; and social, cultural and personality psychology. The department values multidisciplinary collaboration and emphasizes both scientific rigor and applied engagement with the community.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Applicants must meet the following minimum qualifications:
   

  

* PhD in Psychology or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum rank of Associate Professor (Professor preferred).
* A record of effective and inclusive academic leadership, including experience in personnel management and decision\-making.
* Evidence of excellence in teaching, research and service.
* Experience with program accreditation, curriculum development and faculty evaluation.
* Familiarity with North American models of higher education.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 In addition to the above, the college will give preference to candidates who demonstrate:
   

  

* Experience as a department chair, program director or equivalent academic leadership role.
* Success in developing and supporting undergraduate and/or graduate programs.
* Commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration within the college and across the university.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor faculty, support student engagement and foster research productivity.
* A clear vision for the future development of the department, consistent with the strategic goals of the college and university.


**Responsibilities**
 The Head of Department will:
   

  

* Provide strategic leadership and foster a collegial and inclusive departmental culture.
* Foster and promote the professional growth of faculty in teaching and research.
* Oversee curriculum planning, program assessment and accreditation.
* Represent and advocate for the department within the college and university.
* Recruit and retain high\-quality faculty and students.
* Engage in teaching and scholarship at the undergraduate and/or graduate level.
* Participate in university service and governance.


**Date of Commencement**
 The position begins mid\-August 2026\.
   

  

**Application Procedure**
 Applicants should apply online at \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01");" rel\="nofollow"\>https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01\.
   

  

**Applicants Should Submit**
* A cover letter describing their research, teaching and administrative experience, and articulating their vision for how they can contribute to the department’s development and success.
* A current curriculum vitae.
* Names and contact information for three referees (references will be contacted only for shortlisted candidates).


*Additional materials may be requested from candidates advancing to later stages of the search.*
 Applications received by December 15, 2025, will receive full consideration; review will continue until the position is filled.
   

  

**About American University Of Sharjah**
 American University of Sharjah (AUS) is a comprehensive, independent, non\-profit, coeducational institution of higher education that promotes excellence in teaching, learning, research and creative work. AUS fosters a community that celebrates diversity and whose members are committed to the ideals of open intellectual inquiry, ethical behavior and civic responsibility.
   

  

 AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to approximately 6,000 students from over 100 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. Among the top 18 percent of ranked universities in the world (QS World University Rankings, 2026\), AUS is consistently among the top ten universities in the Arab region (QS Arab Region University Rankings, 2026\).
   

  

 AUS is located in the heart of Sharjah’s University City, adjacent to the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park and just minutes from Sharjah International Airport and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The campus is situated in a vibrant and cosmopolitan area offering abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.aus.edu.

**Company Description**
 At QIMA, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust.
   

  

 Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
   

  

 We combine on\-the\-ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data.
   

  

 What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
   

  

 Our Consumer Products Division is dedicated to helping brands, retailers and manufacturers worldwide deliver safe, quality and ethically made products to their consumers. Every day at work, our inspectors, auditors, lab techs, and certification specialists use their expertise to help safeguard the products you use every day in your home: from clothes and footwear to toys and baby products, to electronics, appliances, and furniture.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Role in Brief**
 The Manager \- Client Service \& Global Program will manage the Client Services and Program Department, maintaining a high level of service quality, understanding client needs, and developing strong client relationships, while ensuring compliance with regulatory programs such as SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT. This role will report directly to the Head of Certification Unit working as part of our Client Service \& Program team.
   

  

 The purpose of QIMA’s Client Service \& Program team is to deliver seamless certification experience to our clients by managing key programs and ensuring the highest standards of client satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Supervise the Program Management \& Client Service Team and ensure continuous monitoring of service quality and operational efficiency.
* Manage and maintain client relationships to enhance the customer service experience, ensuring service quality and efficient operations.
* Identify and seek further business opportunities while developing relationships with new clients.
* Oversee client’s programs and maintain understanding of regulatory program requirements including SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT.
* Support the Sales Team to resolve client enquiries and problems with consistency and accuracy.
* Handle ad\-hoc assignments as required.
* Champion an AI\-first mindset by promoting the use of AI tools and technologies in day\-to\-day operations and encouraging experimentation and adoption of AI\-driven solutions to improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and elevate service quality.


**Qualifications**
**To succeed in this role, you have:**
* Diploma or degree holder in any discipline; Electrical, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering background is a plus.
* Fluent in written and spoken English; Chinese or Arabic speaking is an advantage and preferable.
* 5\+ years of working experience in operations and client service within a certification body; experience in testing laboratory management and in\-depth technical knowledge are an advantage.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in managing a team, customer service, and client management.
* Self\-initiated, independent, and a good team player.
* 5\+ years of total experience; experience in certification bodies with team management responsibilities is highly valued.
* Familiarity with regulatory programs such as SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT is a strong advantage.
* A genuine enthusiasm for Artificial Intelligence and its practical applications in operations, quality control, or client management; experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity and decision\-making is a strong plus.


**Additional Information**
 Because our differences make the difference, at QIMA we are proud to promote inclusive diversity and equal opportunities! Our policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
   

  

*QIMA recognizes and recruits all its talents.*

**Job Overview

 The Projects Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and successful delivery of all projects within the organization. The role oversees the full project lifecycle from pre\-construction through execution and handover, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Projects Director operates as the senior authority across all project teams, aligning engineering, procurement, commercial, and site operations with the company’s business objectives and premium construction standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities
 
 :** 




 Strategic Leadership \& Portfolio Management
 


* Lead and oversee the entire project portfolio from inception to final handover.
* Define project governance structures, reporting frameworks, and performance benchmarks.
* Align project execution strategy with corporate financial and operational objectives.
* Review and approve master schedules, budgets, and procurement strategies.
* Establish project performance KPIs, including cost variance, schedule variance, productivity, and margin.



 Project Execution \& Operational Excellence
 


* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with contractual obligations and company standards.

 Financial \& Commercial Management
 


* Oversee project budgeting, forecasting, and cost control mechanisms.

 Risk, Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure compliance with UAE construction regulations, safety standards, and contractual requirements.
* Implement enterprise\-level risk mitigation strategies across all active projects.

* Ensure implementation of quality assurance and quality control systems across sites.



 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Lead, mentor, and evaluate Project Managers, Construction Managers, and Engineering teams.

* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to manage a diverse team and maintain project momentum.

* Results\-driven with a high accountability and ownership mindset.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented with a problem\-solving mindset.

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
