data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Head of Complex Change is accountable for the hands‑on execution and successful delivery of RAKBANK’s most complex, cross‑functional, and strategically critical transformation programmes. The role owns end‑to‑end delivery outcomes—time, scope, and budget—across multi‑platform, multi‑vendor, and multi‑year initiatives with board‑level visibility and CBUAE scrutiny. Acting as the bank’s delivery field commander, the incumbent manages complexity, controls scope, and drives proactive risk mitigation. The role serves as the primary delivery interface with Tier‑1 technology partners and offshore delivery teams, ensuring execution quality and accountability. It requires deep, proven experience in leading large‑scale banking transformations to measurable outcomes.
 



  





  





**What You will Do** 



* Own executive delivery accountability for RAKBANK’s most complex transformation programmes across core banking, digital, payments, and infrastructure.
* Ensure programmes are delivered to committed scope, timelines, and budgets with clear, outcome‑based ownership.
* Lead proactive risk identification and mitigation through deep upfront assessments and a live, senior‑reviewed RAID framework.
* Enforce rigorous scope management and prevent scope creep via disciplined change control and executive escalation.
* Act as the primary delivery interface with Tier‑1 technology partners and vendors, ensuring contractual accountability and milestone delivery.
* Lead and align Offshore Development Centres and offshore delivery teams to programme plans, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Design and mobilise complex, multi‑year programme structures, governance forums, and inter‑workstream dependencies.
* Chair programme steering and governance forums, resolving blockers and escalating issues to CTO, ExCo, and CEO as required.
* Coordinate regulatory, audit, compliance, and risk engagement for programmes under CBUAE scrutiny.
* Produce board‑quality, risk‑adjusted programme reporting and build delivery leadership capability across programme managers and change leads.



  





**What You Will Brin** 



* 20\+ years of progressive technology and transformation leadership, with a minimum of 5 years in an EVP, MD, Programme Director, or CXO\-adjacent delivery leadership role within a bank or globally regulated financial institution.
* Demonstrated track record of personally leading and successfully completing multi\-year, cross\-platform transformation programmes in banking — specifically including core banking migration or major platform upgrade, payments modernisation, or digital platform transformation.
* Expert\-level command of upfront risk management, scope control, and delivery governance in complex, multi\-vendor programme environments — with evidence of having prevented or resolved scope creep and delivery crises in prior engagement.
* Proven experience managing Tier\-1 vendor relationships and ODC/offshore delivery partnerships within programme scope — holding external parties to contractual accountability and delivery standard.
* Expert command of enterprise programme governance frameworks (MSP, PMI\-PgMP, or equivalent) and the ability to adapt these pragmatically to the pace and constraints of live banking transformation.
* Experience engaging with central bank regulators (CBUAE, FCA, MAS, or equivalent) on technology change submissions and supervisory engagement, in partnership with governance and compliance function.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA, MSP Practitioner, or PMI\-PgMP certification highly preferred.



  





**What We are Not Looking for:** 




 ❌ A coordinator or status‑reporting PMO profile that tracks plans but does not personally own delivery outcomes, risk decisions, and executive accountability.
 



 ❌ A leader who reacts to issues after escalation, rather than proactively identifying, structuring, and mitigating complex delivery risks upfront.
 



 ❌ A purely theoretical transformation expert with “exposure” to large programmes, but without proven, hands‑on experience delivering multi‑platform banking transformations under board and regulatory scrutiny.

 We are seeking an experienced Corporate Tax Director to lead complex engagements across the UAE, advising multinational groups, regional conglomerates, family offices and sovereign wealth funds on UAE Corporate Tax and related advisory matters.  You will support the Corporate Tax Partners and lead and oversee a diverse portfolio covering advisory, compliance, controversy, and transactions: 
 



 Client leadership and advisory

 Engagement delivery and quality

* Ensure accurate WIP, billing, and cash collection; deliver profitable growth against targets.

**Qualifications and experience** 



* 12\+ years of relevant corporate/international tax experience, with significant time in a Big Four or leading law/consulting firm; strong UAE/GCC exposure required.
* Deep technical command of UAE Corporate Tax law and guidance.
* Proven track record leading large, multi‑jurisdictional engagements and managing senior client stakeholders.
* Demonstrable business development success, with experience originating and closing sizable advisory projects.
* Strong understanding of IFRS tax accounting (IAS 12\) and reporting for groups; familiarity with GloBE deferred tax, safe harbours, and data requirements will be an advantage.
* Experience with Revenue Authority interactions, audits, rulings/clarifications, and dispute strategies will be an advantage.



**Education and professional credentials** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, Economics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Recognised tax/accounting qualification preferred (e.g., ADIT, CTA, ACA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent).
* Arabic language skills are advantageous; fluency in English is required.



**Technical and leadership competencies** 



* Expert written and oral communication, with the ability to translate complex rules into pragmatic, commercially grounded advice.
* Strong financial modelling and data literacy; ability to guide clients on tax data, systems, and controls, including Pillar Two data readiness.
* High judgment and negotiation skills; capable of defending positions and navigating regulatory dialogue.
* Inclusive leadership, team building, and coaching at scale; resilient under pressure with excellent project management discipline.



**Technology and data** 




 You are proficient with MS Office and tax compliance platforms, and familiar with data extraction and transformation for tax compliance and reporting. **Job Title:** 
 Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA
   

  

**Work Location:** 
 Dubai
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA is responsible for leading and transforming the regional technical delivery organization into a scalable, high\-performing, and standardized function. This role centralizes technical leadership across all countries (including UKI, ME, South Africa, Italy, France and DACH), establishing a unified operating model that ensures consistent implementation quality, strong governance, and measurable delivery outcomes across InterSystems EHR and HealthShare solutions.
   

  

 The position drives operational efficiency through structured resource management, cross\-regional collaboration, and the adoption of shared tools, reusable assets, and standardized processes. It enables the transition from country\-based execution to a coordinated EMEA\-wide delivery model, improving flexibility, utilization, and responsiveness to project demands.
   

  

 In addition, the role plays a critical part in aligning technical delivery with quality objectives, ensuring each country can meet its project targets while benefiting from regional synergies. It is also accountable for embedding AI\-driven methodologies, including the evolution of ARIES, into day\-to\-day delivery practices to enhance predictability, quality, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Overall, this position is key to improving customer outcomes, strengthening partner ecosystems, and building a future\-ready technical implementation capability across EMEA.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead and unify all Technical Implementation teams across EMEA under a single functional structure, ensuring consistent standards and execution.
* Define and enforce technical implementation best practices, governance, and quality frameworks across all projects.
* Maintain strong alignment with country leadership, ensuring technical delivery supports each country in achieving its annual project targets while applying regional synergies and continuous improvements.
* Drive cross\-country collaboration and resource optimization, enabling flexible deployment of technical expertise across the region.
* Own regional technical capacity planning, forecasting, and utilization, leveraging data and AI\-driven insights.
* Oversee partner strategy and execution, including onboarding, performance management, and management alignment.
* Embed and scale the AI\-powered ARIES methodology across all technical delivery activities.
* Establish and monitor KPIs related to delivery quality, efficiency, resource utilization, and partner performance.
* Support country Professional Services Directors in achieving project success, while maintaining strong technical oversight.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including reusable assets, automation, and standardization of deliverables.
* Act as a senior stakeholder in customer engagements, supporting critical projects and ensuring delivery excellence.


**Qualifications:**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical delivery, implementation, or professional services leadership.
* Proven track record managing large\-scale, complex, multi\-country implementation programs.
* Strong background in healthcare IT or enterprise software implementation environments.
* Deep understanding of technical architectures, integration, and data platforms.
* Experience with resource management, forecasting, and operational optimization at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational transformation and drive standardization.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills in a matrix environment.
* Experience working with partners and external delivery ecosystems.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate vision into execution.
* Ability to travel internationally 60% of the time.


**Education and Training:**
* Relevant University technical Degree
* Proficiency in English


**Key Success Factors:**
* Improved delivery predictability and quality across EMEA
* Increased resource utilization and cross\-regional efficiency
* Strong partner performance and optimization
* Effective adoption of AI\-driven implementation practices
* Scalable and standardized technical delivery model across EMEA markets

data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent network, and works alongside the VP to close exhibition packages, sponsorship inventory, and feature areas. The role is the senior commercial operator on the AixEnergy team and is accountable for the Year 1 close and the Year 2 rebooking pipeline captured on\-site plus any additional AixEnergy edition launches.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:**




 Own the AixEnergy Asia 2026 exhibition and sponsorship pipeline end\-to\-end: prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and contract close. Carry an individual revenue target and report progress weekly against the Revenue Pathway forecast.
 



 Open and convert priority accounts across hyperscalers, data centre operators, energy and utility companies, EPCs, industrial real estate developers, and AI infrastructure vendors. Build credible peer\-level relationships with senior commercial decision\-makers and convert verbal interest into signed contracts.
 



  





 Manage and grow the AixEnergy agent network. Set agent targets, brief on pricing and proposition, and quality\-control agent\-sourced leads before they enter the AixEnergy pipeline.
 



 Work on sponsorship sales to convert sponsorship inventory: title partner, strategic partners, theatre and feature sponsorships, and on\-site activations.
 



  





 Maintain Salesforce hygiene to dmg events standard: every opportunity logged, staged, weighted, and updated weekly. Provide accurate weekly forecasts to the VP and into the WSR (Weekly Sales Report) cadence, with clear flags on slipped, won, and at\-risk deals.
 



  





 Maintain working knowledge of the AI infrastructure and energy markets: track competitor events, pricing benchmarks, exhibitor movements, and account\-level developments that affect AixEnergy's pipeline and pricing. Feed market intelligence back into the proposition and the floor plan.
 



 Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance to ensure the commercial pipeline is fed, supported, and delivered. Brief Marketing on priority targets and EDM cadence; align with Operations on floor plan, build, and exhibitor delivery; coordinate with Finance on contracting, invoicing, and collections.
 



  





 Deliver a strong on\-site rebooking result for AixEnergy 2027, including target rebooking rate (40%\+) by end of show, signed Letters of Intent for 2027, and a qualified Year 2 pipeline document handed to the team within 30 days of the close of the 2026 edition.
 



  





**Job Context:**




 AixEnergy Asia 2026 is a launch\-edition event. The Commercial Director is joining at a critical phase of the cycle and is expected to close the gap to budget through direct sales, agent activation, and conversion of the existing pipeline. The event is co\-located with Gastech 2026 in Bangkok but operates as a standalone product with its own P\&L, exhibition, sponsorship inventory, and conference. The Commercial Director reports to the VP ADIPEC \& Business Development and works alongside the Operations Director, the Marketing Director and the Head of Content. The role requires a senior operator capable of working independently in an early\-stage commercial environment, holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale and energy executives, and delivering against a hard September 2026 close.
 



  





**Qualifications, Experience, \& Skills:**




 Technical / Functional: Minimum 7 years senior B2B exhibition and sponsorship sales experience, with a track record of personally carrying and delivering revenue targets in excess of US$1m. Demonstrable success selling at a senior, peer\-level into AI infrastructure, data centres, energy, utilities, or industrial sectors. Experience launching first\-edition events strongly preferred. Working knowledge of Salesforce or equivalent CRM is essential. Familiarity with ASEAN markets, particularly Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia, is an advantage. Experience working with sales agents and channel partners. Understanding of how exhibition, sponsorship, and conference content combine into a single commercial proposition. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
 



  





 Personal Attributes / Interpersonal: Senior commercial presence; comfortable holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale procurement leads, energy company executives, and EPC commercial directors. Closer’s instinct: identifies the path to contract early and drives the deal to signature. Self\-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate effectively in a launch\-phase environment without established processes or large team support. Resilient under pressure; comfortable with hard targets, weekly forecast scrutiny, and a non\-negotiable September 2026 close. Disciplined with CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy. Collaborative across Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance; treats the pipeline as a shared commercial asset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Willing to travel internationally as required, including to Bangkok ahead of and during the September 2026 event.
 



  





**dmg events is an equal opportunity employer. If you have not had feedback from us within 14 days, please consider your application as unsuccessful for this round.**

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an accomplished Director – Major Projects \& Infrastructure to lead the strategic planning and delivery of major transport and infrastructure design programmes across the Middle East. * Establish clear governance, decision\-making frameworks, and performance expectations across programmes to support consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Represent the business externally with clients, partners, and industry stakeholders, strengthening market profile and helping secure future opportunities.
* Work closely with peers and the broader leadership team in an effective and collaborative manner.


**Project \& Programme Management**
* Lead the delivery of major transport and infrastructure projects from concept through detailed design and construction support, ensuring programmes are structured, resourced, and governed effectively.
* Own programme performance against schedule, budget, margin, cash flow, and quality targets, with clear accountability for forecasting, financial control, and overall portfolio health.
* Drive programme controls including risk management, change control, reporting, KPI monitoring, schedule assurance, and recovery planning across multi\-package and multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Oversee resource planning and coordination across multi\-disciplinary teams to maintain delivery efficiency and effective interface management.


**Client \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, government authorities, and strategic partners across the region, including ministries, commissions, municipalities, and major development entities.
* Act as the senior client interface for major programmes, leading executive discussions, resolving complex issues, and maintaining confidence in delivery performance and commercial outcomes.
* Oversee stakeholder coordination and authority engagement, including support for approvals, permitting, and resolution of issues affecting programme progress.


**Technical Excellence**
* Provide technical leadership across engineering solutions, mobility strategies, and design methodologies, ensuring that projects are innovative, practical, and aligned with client objectives.
* Ensure robust technical assurance and compliance with international standards, local authority requirements, design safety obligations, and organisational quality systems.
* Champion digital engineering, BIM, model\-based delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and consistency across programmes.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and inspire high\-performing multi\-disciplinary teams, setting clear expectations for delivery, collaboration, and professional standards.
* Build organisational capability through effective resource planning, performance management, knowledge sharing, and development of specialist and leadership talent.
* Support recruitment, succession planning, and retention strategies to strengthen long\-term capability across the transport and infrastructure business.


**Qualifications**

* 20\+ years of experience delivering major transport and infrastructure projects, with at least 10 years in the Middle East.
* Proven leadership experience on mega‑projects such as highways programmes, mobility corridors, rail/metro interfaces, smart mobility projects, and integrated infrastructure developments.
* Strong background in multi‑disciplinary design management, including roads, highways, bridges and utilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large consultant and contractor teams within complex programme environments, with strong capability in resource planning, delivery oversight, and interface management.
* Excellent knowledge of international and regional codes, design standards, and approval processes.
* Sound understanding of design safety, HSE leadership, regulatory compliance, and authority approvals processes across major infrastructure programmes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and client‑facing skills with experience engaging with ministries and major authorities.
* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including experience with bid leadership, consultancy frameworks, contract strategy, procurement interfaces, change management, and programme financial performance.
* Experience managing programme performance through governance, reporting, KPIs, and executive\-level decision\-making in high\-profile delivery environments.
* Experience working with large engineering consultancies on high\-profile regional projects.
* Chartered/Professional Engineer status (CEng, PE, PEng, etc.) is highly desirable.

**Human Resources Director** 




**Location:** 
 Dubai, United Arab Emirates
 



  





 Role Overview:
 



 We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Director to lead the HR function for a growing construction business based in Dubai. This role will focus heavily on talent acquisition, workforce planning, compensation and benefits strategy, and building scalable HR frameworks to support project\-based operations across the UAE and wider region.
 



 The HR Director will act as a strategic partner to executive leadership, ensuring the organisation attracts, develops, and retains top\-tier talent while maintaining compliance with UAE labour laws and industry regulations.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
 


* Develop and implement a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with business growth and project pipeline demands.
* Lead high\-volume recruitment across technical, engineering, project management, and corporate functions.
* Build strong talent pipelines for critical construction roles (e.g., project directors, engineers, quantity surveyors, site managers).
* Establish employer branding initiatives to position the company as an employer of choice within the construction sector.
* Oversee recruitment partners, agencies, and international hiring campaigns where required.
* Implement workforce planning models to ensure manpower forecasting aligns with project timelines.



 2\. Compensation \& Benefits
 


* Design and implement competitive compensation and benefits frameworks aligned with market benchmarks in the UAE construction industry.
* Lead salary benchmarking exercises and ensure internal equity across roles and geographies.
* Develop incentive schemes linked to project performance and business outcomes.
* Oversee benefits administration including health insurance, allowances, bonuses, and expatriate packages.
* Ensure compliance with WPS (Wage Protection System) and UAE Labour Law requirements.



 3\. HR Strategy \& Leadership
 


* Develop and execute the overall HR strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Establish HR policies, procedures, and governance frameworks suitable for a project\-driven environment.
* Lead organisational design initiatives to support business expansion.
* Provide strategic counsel to senior leadership on people\-related matters.



 4\. Employee Relations \& Compliance
 


* Ensure full compliance with UAE Labour Law and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee employee relations matters including disciplinary processes and conflict resolution.
* Develop retention and engagement strategies to reduce turnover across site\-based and corporate employees.



 5\. Performance Management \& Development
 


* Implement performance management frameworks aligned with KPIs and project milestones.
* Support leadership development and succession planning initiatives.
* Promote a culture of accountability, safety, and high performance.



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within construction, engineering, or infrastructure sectors.
* Strong expertise in talent acquisition within project\-based environments.
* Proven experience designing compensation and benefits frameworks in the UAE market.
* In\-depth knowledge of UAE Labour Law and HR compliance requirements.
* Experience managing multi\-site or geographically dispersed workforces.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Professional HR certification (CIPD, SHRM, or equivalent) preferred.

AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

data.jd_text:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award\-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.
   

  

 We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo \& Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.
   

  

 We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 AESG is seeking an experienced BIM Manager with deep expertise in data center and mission critical facility design to join our Mission Critical department. Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead BIM implementation, coordination, and delivery across diverse data center projects throughout the EMEA region, as well as occasional building services projects including hotels, offices, and commercial developments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in BIM processes and digital design delivery with proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary coordination for hyperscale data center operators. This role requires hands\-on involvement in model production, team supervision, and technical delivery, while acting as the Lead Appointed Party under ISO 19650 for assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Lead Appointed Party for BIM delivery in accordance with ISO 19650, with formal authority to accept, reject, or delay information deliveries that do not meet agreed standards and client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
* Develop and maintain project\-level BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP), and review/approve Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDP) submitted by design disciplines
* Establish and manage Common Data Environment (CDE) structures using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, including project setup, access control, folder structures, workflow configuration, status codes, and information containers (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archive)
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, chairing clash detection reviews, coordination meetings, and issue resolution sessions with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialist disciplines
* Enforce BIM standards, protocols, and quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650, BSRIA BG6 guidance for MEP, hyperscaler\-specific requirements and client specifications
* Supervise and mentor project BIM teams on Revit best practices, family creation, parametric modeling, and workflow optimization, while maintaining hands\-on involvement in complex modeling tasks
* Manage COBie\-compliant asset data structuring and delivery for facilities management handover, supporting construction phase information delivery and digital twin integration
* Prepare and deliver BIM coordination reports, clash reports, design validation summaries, model quality audits, and lessons learned documentation
* Support business development through BIM capability presentations, technical demonstrations, and proposal preparation
* Identify and escalate BIM delivery risks early, implementing structured risk management procedures


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years progressive experience as BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or senior BIM role with significant focus on data center and mission critical facilities
* Proven application of ISO 19650 on live projects, including experience as Lead Appointed Party or within ISO 19650\-compliant frameworks, with working knowledge of EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP documentation
* Demonstrated expertise delivering projects for hyperscale operators (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) with deep understanding of their Revit templates, family libraries, naming conventions, and coordination workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) including parametric modeling, family creation, phasing, worksets, design options, view templates, and advanced scheduling, with hands\-on modeling experience
* Expert\-level experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 administration, and strong expertise in Navisworks for 3D coordination, clash detection, and 4D sequencing
* Practical experience with COBie asset data structuring and familiarity with BSRIA BG6 Building Services BIM guidance
* Proven track record delivering data center projects across design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and EPC frameworks, coordinating mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, civil, and specialist disciplines (fire protection, security, telecom)
* Significant experience with projects in GCC and broader EMEA region, with understanding of regional BIM maturity levels, local codes, and stakeholder dynamics
* Strong technical background in building services engineering with ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, understand construction methods, building systems, and MEP coordination requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to explain technical BIM concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and lead coordination meetings
* Proactive, structured approach with demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk and hold authority to challenge non\-compliant information
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; professional certifications (Autodesk Certified Professional, buildingSMART certifications) preferred


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Advanced BIM tools: Dynamo for Revit automation, Solibri for model checking, Bluebeam for PDF coordination, digital twin platforms for operational handover
* Point cloud processing and scan\-to\-BIM workflows for existing facility documentation
* Computational design and visual scripting (Dynamo, Grasshopper) for design automation
* Sustainable design coordination experience (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) and energy modeling integration (IES VE, IES Apache, DesignBuilder)
* Data center\-specific BIM knowledge: hot/cold aisle modeling, cable tray routing for high\-density power, precision cooling coordination, raised floor systems, structured cabling infrastructure
* Federated model coordination strategies, including coordination sequencing, trade\-specific clash priorities, and progressive coordination approaches
* 4D scheduling integration (Navisworks Timeliner, Synchro) for construction sequencing visualization
* Understanding of data center monitoring systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS) and BIM coordination with operational systems
* Experience supporting construction phase information delivery and commissioning coordination
* Mentoring capabilities with experience guiding junior BIM coordinators and modelers
* Project management skills including planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast\-paced environments while maintaining quality standards


**What We Offer**
* Clear career progression with increasing leadership responsibilities as the department and BIM maturity expand
* Exposure to diverse mission critical projects across EMEA, working with leading hyperscaler operators and regional data center developers
* Direct reporting to Head of Mission Critical with significant autonomy to shape BIM processes, standards, and digital design delivery
* Hands\-on involvement with cutting\-edge data center projects including campus\-scale developments, high\-density AI infrastructure, and liquid cooling implementations
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
* Professional development opportunities including training, industry conferences, and certifications

data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Head of QA is RAKBANK's enterprise quality authority — a strategic leadership role accountable for transforming the bank's approach to software quality from a phase\-end testing gate into a continuous, embedded quality engineering discipline woven into every stage of the S
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Head of QA is RAKBANK's enterprise quality authority — a strategic leadership role accountable for transforming the bank's approach to software quality from a phase\-end testing gate into a continuous, embedded quality engineering discipline woven into every stage of the SDLC. RAKBANK's current testing landscape is predominantly manual, with limited automation coverage and a reactive quality culture. This role is explicitly mandated to change that reality: to build a world\-class QA practice characterised by automation\-first delivery, AI\-driven testing, shift\-left quality principles, intelligent test data management, and quality gates embedded within CI/CD pipelines. The Head of QA owns the entire quality engineering strategy, toolchain, governance, and team — partnering with DevEx, Platform Engineering, and delivery squads to ensure every software release meets the quality bar required by a CBUAE\-regulated bank serving retail, SME, and wholesale customers.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Define and own the enterprise
 **quality engineering strategy** 
 , roadmap, KPIs, and automation coverage targets.
* Establish and lead a
 **Quality Engineering Centre of Excellence** 
 , publishing standards, golden paths, and tooling guidelines.
* Govern
 **quality gates across the full SDLC** 
 , enforcing entry and exit criteria across all testing stages.
* Drive
 **shift‑left quality adoption** 
 , embedding QA into squads and promoting BDD/TDD and shared accountability.
* Own the
 **test automation programme** 
 , including framework governance and automation ROI tracking.
* Lead adoption of
 **AI‑assisted testing** 
 , including LLM‑based test generation, self‑healing automation, and intelligent prioritisation.
* Establish
 **intelligent test data management** 
 , including synthetic data, masking, and self‑service provisioning.
* Own
 **non‑functional quality engineering** 
 , covering performance, resilience, chaos engineering, and API contract testing.
* Define and govern
 **test environment strategy** 
 , enabling automated and on‑demand environment provisioning.
* Represent quality at
 **programme and release governance forums** 
 , owning UAT coordination, go/no‑go decisions, and executive quality reporting.



**What you will bring:** 



* 12\+ years in software quality engineering, including senior QA leadership experience in a bank or regulated financial institution.
* Proven leadership of a manual‑to‑automation, shift‑left QA transformation integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Deep expertise in test automation frameworks and test management platforms.
* Strong hands‑on experience with performance and resilience testing for critical financial systems.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating and governing AI‑assisted testing tools.
* Expert knowledge of test data governance, including synthetic data and PII masking.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; ISTQB Advanced Test Manager required.



  





**What We Are Not Looking For:** 




 ❌ A
 **traditional, phase‑end testing manager** 
 who treats QA as a final gate rather than an embedded engineering discipline across the SDLC.
 



 ❌ A leader
 **comfortable with manual‑heavy testing models** 
 , without a strong track record of driving automation‑first, CI/CD‑integrated quality transformations.
 



 ❌ A candidate
 **without appetite or credibility in AI‑assisted testing** 
 , self‑healing automation, or intelligent test prioritisation as part of modern QA practice.
 



 ❌ A purely operational QA head who
 **executes tests but does not define strategy** 
 , influence engineering culture, or establish enterprise quality standards.
 



 ❌ A profile
 **unfamiliar with regulated banking environments** 
 , unable to balance delivery speed with CBUAE‑grade quality, resiliency, and governance expectations.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 



* To support the Bank’s business strategy by acquiring and managing high\-net\-worth (HNW) clients. The role requires a UAE National Relationship Manager with a strong background in wealth management, capable of delivering tailored financial solutions, enhancing client relationships, and contributing to the growth of the Bank’s HNW client base.
* The role is required to acquire/ transfer HNW clients’ portfolios to Emirates Investment Bank to generate fee income and Assets Under Management (AUM).
* The role must work closely with team leaders, Head of Business Development and Investment Advisors to ensure client product suitability is maintained as per the internal policies.



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Client Acquisition and Revenue:** 



* To source new qualified clients for Wealth Management business based on the business plan submitted at the time of on\-boarding.
* To ensure generation of net fee income through the sale of Investment products and to generate the required Assets under Management (AUM).
* To maintain regular contact with the client including regular face\-to\-face meetings and maintain call reports of all client activities.
* To profile the clients’ risk and return aspirations and work with Investment Advisors to maintain client risk profile suitability at all times.
* To increase assets under management of existing clients and develop the relationship.
* To provide and maintain, on an ongoing basis, a monthly report, figures, forecasting and any other records which may be required by the Team Leader to keep up\-to\-date records of sales \& performance.
* To do account planning with Team Leader and Head of Distribution and Investment Advisors to understand the needs of the client and provide appropriate financial solutions to the client.
* To ensure consistent service delivery is maintained at all touch points for clients.
* To continuously provide feedback on competitive activities to the Product and Business team to track market developments.
* To attend regular product trainings and to be updated with the financial market developments.
* To safeguard the Bank’s reputation by ensuring ethical and professional behavior is maintained at all times.
* To maintain superior client service levels by pro\-actively meeting the clients on regular basis and pre\-empting any possible client complaints and concerns.



  





**Client Portfolio Management:** 



* To maintain and enhance new and existing relationships with key and prospective clients to ensure business continuity and growth.
* To provide regular updates to the Head of Business Development/ Wealth Management on performance of the portfolio accounts and on key market updates which may impact client attrition.
* To analyse the client’s financial standing to assess the credit risk for the client and ensure that the credit quality of the portfolio is not compromised.
* To recommend/reject or approve credit facilities, within prescribed limits, after a comprehensive analysis of the client’s net worth and proposed financial standing.
* To ensure provision of high quality and timely service to clients.



**Internal Collaboration:** 



* To monitor service level agreements and manage the coordination with other departments to meet client service expectations.
* To engage with key stakeholders including on\-boarding team, credit, operations, technology, and treasury to deliver a timely and effective level of client experience.



**Regulatory and Compliance:** 



* To ensure that the client being on\-boarded is of good reputation and financial standing and will maintain proper financial and KYC documentation at all times.
* To ensure customer documentation is complete and in line with the Bank’s requirements.
* To help service coordinators in resolving documentation and other client\-related discrepancies.
* To adhere to a robust control framework, ensuring communications with clients meet internal control standards and external regulatory requirements.
* To ensure clients’ KYC and risk profile are reviewed regularly as per compliance policy, and is updated with any new changes in clients’ financial status.
* To ensure risk assessment of the client portfolio is maintained by personally reviewing all proposals, identifying, and assessing all risk inherent in credit exposures.
* To ensure all compliance/ credit and AML queries are answered within 48 hours.
* To ensure all internal and external trainings are attended and CPD hours are completed.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Overall, 10\-15years of experience in Banking and minimum 5\-10 years of experience in Wealth Management/ Private Banking/ Asset Management.
* Proficient in MS Office.
* CISI qualification

With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.

The
 **Head of Business Intelligence** 
 will own and lead the end\-to\-end BI strategy, architecture and insight delivery across the business. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable intelligence that enables leadership teams to make faster, smarter and more profitable decisions.
 



 You will build and lead a high\-performing BI function, establish best\-in\-class reporting standards, and partner closely with Commercial, Trading, Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and senior leadership to drive measurable business impact.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial acumen and the ability to translate data into decision\-ready insight.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**BI Strategy \& Architecture** 



* Define and own the group\-wide BI roadmap across DTC and marketplace channels.
* Translate trading, pricing, merchandising, supply chain and finance requirements into scalable data models and reporting layers.
* Design and maintain a single source of truth across brands, regions and channels, despite fragmented upstream systems.
* Set clear ownership of raw data, transformed layers, business logic and reporting views.



**Data Integration \& Pipelines** 



* Lead the structuring and transformation of core data tables including orders, traffic, pricing, promotions, logistics, inventory and returns.
* Build and maintain robust pipelines to support daily, weekly and near real\-time trading decisions.
* Partner closely with technology and data teams to improve data reliability, timeliness and accessibility, and to define new data fields or views where required.



**Reporting, Dashboards \& Analytics** 



* Design decision\-first dashboards that drive action, not just visibility.
* Create standardised reporting frameworks while accommodating brand\-level nuances.
* Enable self\-serve analytics for trading, finance and senior leadership teams.



**Business Partnering \& Decision Support** 



* Act as a strategic BI partner to Trading and Commercial teams, proactively surfacing insights, risks and opportunities.
* Help evolve the organisation from reactive reporting to proactive and predictive insight.



**Data Governance \& Quality** 



* Define clear data definitions, metric logic and documentation to eliminate multiple versions of the truth.
* Implement data quality checks, alerts and reconciliation processes to ensure trust in reporting.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* 12\+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics or Data, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Strong background in e\-commerce, fashion retail or consumer\-facing brands.
* Expert\-level SQL (BigQuery preferred) and deep understanding of modern data warehousing and modelling concepts.
* Advanced experience with BI tools such as Tableau or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar for data analysis, automation or advanced analytics.
* Strong commercial mindset with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Experience building and scaling BI teams in fast\-growth, high\-change environments.

Executive Opportunity: Head of Regional Sales (MEA)
 



  





 Zenith Technologies
 



 Location: Riyadh, KSA based
 



 Start Date: Immediate
 



 ⸻
 



 About Zenith
 



  





 Zenith Technologies, founded in Melbourne and established across Australasia and the Middle East, is a recognized leader in Homeland Security, Intelligence Systems, and Advanced Security Technologies.
 



  





 For over 15 years, Zenith has partnered with governments, ministries of interior, defense organizations, and elite law enforcement agencies to deliver end\-to\-end mission\-critical solutions that fuse physical, digital, and cyber domains. Our solutions are engineered entirely in\-house, giving us unmatched flexibility to innovate, customize, and deliver at scale.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Our Portfolio
 



  





 Zenith’s portfolio reflects a track record of world\-first innovations and proprietary platforms that transform how governments and agencies secure their nations. Key domains include:
 



 • Intelligent Mobility \& Enforcement Systems – including the world’s first AI\-powered Intelligent Lightbar, combining ANPR, live data analytics, communications, and edge AI for real\-time enforcement and situational command.
 



 • Next\-Generation ANPR \& Video Analytics – advanced fixed, mobile, and covert platforms enabling real\-time vehicle intelligence, threat detection, and multi\-domain data correlation.
 



 • AI\-Powered Data Fusion \& Analytics – proprietary platforms that ingest and integrate structured and unstructured data streams, delivering actionable intelligence and predictive insights to decision\-makers at speed.
 



 • Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) \& Social Media Monitoring – cutting\-edge solutions for live monitoring, deep\-data correlation, and AI\-enhanced threat intelligence across open sources, social media, and digital ecosystems.
 



 • Command \& Control Solutions – scalable, integrated C4i platforms enabling strategic oversight, rapid response, and mission\-critical decision\-making across multiple agencies.
 



 • Cyber\-Physical Security Integration – bridging digital and physical domains to deliver end\-to\-end national security resilience against emerging threats.
 



  





 Zenith’s unique strength lies in IP ownership and in\-house R\&D, enabling us to deploy fully integrated ecosystems rather than fragmented systems — a decisive advantage in the Homeland Security, National Resilience, and Law Enforcement sectors.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 Zenith is seeking a Head of Regional Sales (MEA) to drive strategic expansion across the GCC, with primary focus on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the Group CEO, this executive will lead Zenith’s market growth, government engagement, and multimillion\-dollar program delivery across one of the world’s most dynamic security environments.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Key Accountabilities
 



 • Define and execute regional sales strategy aligned with Zenith’s growth objectives.
 



 • Lead high\-level engagements with Ministries of Interior, law enforcement, and homeland security agencies across KSA and GCC.
 



 • Manage full lifecycle: pipeline development, bid and proposal management, high\-stakes negotiation, and closure of complex projects.
 



 • Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing regional sales force.
 



 • Establish and deepen strategic alliances with leading system integrators and security partners.
 



 • Deliver strong commercial outcomes while ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and market leadership.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 • 10\+ years in senior sales leadership within Homeland Security, Security Technology, or Defense.
 



 • Minimum 5 years of demonstrable success in the GCC, with direct experience engaging KSA MOI.
 



 • Proven track record in structuring and closing multimillion\-dollar government security contracts.
 



 • Strong professional networks across security, defense, and law enforcement communities in the region.
 



 • Master’s degree (Business or Engineering), MBA preferred.
 



 • Fluent in both Arabic and English.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 What Zenith Offers
 



  





 This is a high\-impact executive mandate within one of the most respected innovation\-driven players in the homeland security sector. Zenith offers:
 



 • Attractive executive package (base \+ commission).
 



 • Opportunity to shape national\-level security transformation.
 



 • A platform to operate at the intersection of AI, intelligence, and homeland security innovation in one of the fastest growing regions globally.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Submit your CV (PDF/Word) to employment@zenith.com.au
 



 Subject line: “Head of Regional Sales (MEA) – \[Your Name]”
 



  





 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you energized by partnering with senior leaders to enable business success through people\-focused solutions? As Head of HR, you will work closely with leaders and their leadership teams across the Middle East with focus on UAE and Saudi\-Arabia to support the delivery of the people agenda.
   

  

 In this role, you will act as a trusted HR advisor on a broad range of people and organizational topics, helping leaders translate business priorities into effective people actions and play an important role in supporting leadership teams through change, organizational development, talent decisions, and workforce planning.
   

  

 This role combines senior HR partnering with hands\-on execution of (a.o.) HR cycle topics.
   

  

**What are my job responsibilities?**
**Strategic HR Leadership \& People Advisory**
* Act as a strategic advisor to Executive Management on all HR and workforce\-related matters
* Partner with leaders to design organizations that effectively support both operational and office\-based teams
* Translate business priorities into practical people\-centered actions that resonate across all workforce segments
* Lead employee relations initiatives, including dispute resolution and organizational interventions


**Workforce Planning, Talent \& Employee Lifecycle**
* Lead workforce planning aligned with business growth and operational realities
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and employee lifecycle processes
* Partner with leadership on hiring strategies, workforce structures, and succession planning
* Ensure smooth onboarding and integration, especially for expatriate and site\-based employees
* Ensure attraction, development, and retention of talent while maintaining workforce stability


**Employee Relations, Labour Law \& Compliance**
* Manage employee relations and labor matters in line with UAE \& KSA labor laws
* Act as a key point of contact for complex employee relations matters, with strong on\-the\-ground involvement
* Build trust with blue\-collar employees through visibility, accessibility, and consistent communication
* Support leaders in resolving employee issues, conflicts, and workplace challenges
* Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant HR practices
* Develop and implement HR policies and conduct audits to ensure governance and continuous improvement


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**
* Implement performance management practices aligned with business goals
* Support leaders in driving performance through effective people management
* Drive career development, succession planning, and talent initiatives
* Foster a high\-performance culture while ensuring employee engagement and sustainable workloads


**Compensation, Benefits \& Employee Value Proposition**
* Design and manage competitive compensation and benefits structures
* Lead salary benchmarking, job evaluations, and incentive programs
* Enhance benefits and offerings to meet both organizational and employee needs


**HR Operations, Systems \& Employee Experience**
* Oversee HR operations including HRIS, payroll coordination, and employee records
* Ensure smooth delivery of employee services (facilities, travel, housing, etc.)
* Manage HR systems, reporting, and workforce analytics
* Drive efficient processes while maintaining a positive employee experience


**HR Transformation, Projects \& Change Management**
* Lead HR transformation and digitalization initiatives
* Manage HR projects end\-to\-end, ensuring delivery and impact
* Drive change management with strong focus on communication, adoption, and employee impact
* Ensure change initiatives are clearly communicated and understood by all workforce segments, including non\-office employees
* Define and track KPIs to measure both business and people outcomes


**What do I need to qualify for this role?**
* Strong experience in an HR Business Partner or HR leadership role, preferably in a global or matrixed organization
* Experience partnering with senior leaders on people, workforce, and organizational topics

 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Category \& Merchandising** 




  





 About the Role
 



  





 Fynde has partnered with a global cross\-border eCommerce platform that specialises in bringing international products to customers across the Middle East and wider international markets. With a strong presence across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, the business simplifies access to millions of global products by managing sourcing, import logistics, and last\-mile delivery through a seamless, consumer\-first digital experience.
 



  





 We are now headhunting a Head of Category \& Merchandising to take strategic and commercial ownership of category performance across the platform, with an initial focus on Health \& Supplements alongside broader involvement across multiple product categories within the organisation.
 



  





 Based in Dubai, this is a commercially driven leadership role focused on category growth, merchandising strategy, localisation, digital trading performance, and customer engagement across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. The position blends category management, product selection, pricing, ecommerce merchandising, analytics, and AI\-enabled optimisation, requiring someone capable of shaping both strategic direction and operational execution within a fast\-paced cross\-border ecommerce environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Category \& Commercial Ownership** 




 Lead the strategy, development, and ongoing performance management of key product categories across the platform, with a particular focus on Health \& Supplements. Drive revenue growth, margin optimisation, customer engagement, and category expansion in alignment with wider business objectives across multiple international markets.
 



  





**Assortment Development \& Curation** 




 Build commercially relevant and scalable product assortments based on customer behaviour, market trends, data analysis, and commercial opportunity. Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen category depth, introduce new products, and optimise the product mix across both regional and international audiences.
 



  





**Product Performance \& Trading Analysis** 




 Use dashboards, sales reporting, customer insights, and trading data to evaluate category performance and identify opportunities for optimisation. Analyse SKU performance, pricing effectiveness, conversion trends, promotional impact, and customer demand to drive commercial decision\-making.
 



  





**Pricing \& Promotional Strategy** 




 Develop and optimise pricing strategies in line with consumer expectations, competitive positioning, and margin objectives. Plan and execute promotional activity to support seasonal campaigns, category growth initiatives, and overall trading performance.
 



  





**Regional \& International Localisation** 




 Support the localisation and optimisation of category content, product presentation, and customer experience across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. Ensure merchandising strategies align with local consumer behaviours, cultural nuances, and evolving market expectations.
 



  





**AI \& Merchandising Automation** 




 Partner with data and technology teams to leverage AI, automation, and merchandising tools to improve category performance. Contribute towards initiatives involving product recommendations, dynamic pricing, search optimisation, inventory visibility, and broader ecommerce automation strategies.
 



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 Work closely with marketing, operations, supply chain, customer experience, and technology teams to ensure strong execution of category plans and alignment across all customer touchpoints.
 



  





**Market Intelligence \& Competitor Benchmarking** 




 Monitor developments across ecommerce, health \& wellness, consumer behaviour, and digital merchandising trends. Benchmark competitor activity, assortment strategy, pricing structures, and promotional campaigns to identify commercial opportunities and areas for improvement.
 



  





**Lifecycle \& Inventory Management** 




 Oversee the full lifecycle management of SKUs, ensuring products remain commercially viable, available, and aligned with category strategy. Collaborate with supply chain and operations teams to support forecasting, replenishment, and inventory optimisation.
 



 Requirements
 



  




* 5\+ years of experience within ecommerce category management, digital merchandising, ecommerce trading, or related commercial functions.
* Strong experience within Health, Supplements, Wellness, FMCG, Consumer Goods, or adjacent ecommerce\-led categories.
* Proven commercial acumen with responsibility for revenue growth, margin optimisation, product mix, and trading performance.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insight into commercial action.
* Experience working alongside AI\-enabled merchandising tools, pricing engines, ecommerce CMS platforms, or automation technologies.
* Understanding of cross\-border ecommerce operations, digital marketplaces, and international trading environments.
* Experience operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, or wider Middle Eastern markets would be highly advantageous.
* Arabic language capabilities would be highly advantageous.
* Entrepreneurial, proactive, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to build, shape, and improve processes within a growing organisation.
* Ability to operate both strategically and hands\-on within a fast\-moving ecommerce environment.
