**Job Purpose**
 Fleet Technical Management at Emirates comprises five specialized teams dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of service and reliability for our fleet.
   

  

**Airframe Systems:** 
 Handles mechanical systems including flight controls, landing gear, and air conditioning.
   

  

**Structures** 
 : Supports aircraft structures, including repairs and modifications for metallic and composite parts.
   

  

**Avionics** 
 : Manages avionics systems, including navigation, communications, and advanced IFE systems.
   

  

**Powerplant** 
 : Oversees engines and APUs, focusing on health monitoring and optimization.
   

  

**Cabin** 
 : Maintains passenger cabins, flight decks, and retrofits, ensuring top\-notch comfort and functionality.
   

  

 Each team ensures our fleet operates efficiently and safely, meeting all technical and service standards.
   

  

 As a Technical Services Engineer I \- Cabin Upgrades and Reconfigurations (Inflight Entertainment and Connectivity) you will provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Emirates fleet to ensure compliance to regulatory \& safety requirements, reliability, passenger comfort and cost effectiveness.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Cabin Interior.
* Routinely evaluate manufacturers/regulatory authorities’ technical documents, taking appropriate actions and update internal engineering documents including Engineering Order and Special Engineering Workcard.
* Review in\-service data (e.g Tech log, Pilot Reports, Defects) and implement actions to improve fleet, engine, component and/or system reliability and maintainability, including optimisation of aircraft maintenance programs.
* Deliver technical assistance and operational support in disruptions scenarios including the handling of technical/AOG, troubleshooting, aircraft chronic and deferred defects and technical delays.
* Carry out Emirates Engineering design organisational activities such as but not limited to development of standard operating procedures, in house repairs, use of alternate parts, deviations from manufacturing documents by exercising Design Engineer (DE) privileges of Part 21 Design Organisation as appointed by Head of Design (HOD).
* Provide support and expertise for acquisition of new Aircraft and end of lease activities
* Act as a technical liaison with Aircraft, Engines and/or Component Manufacturers and internal stakeholders (e.g flight operations, service delivery) to address fleet significant faults, defects, design issues and quality escapements.
* Provide technical clarifications/justification to internal stakeholders in support of cost optimisation, contract negotiation, repair and modification processes.
* Carry out project management functions such as but not limited to major modifications, retrofits, cabin reconfigurations and aircraft phaseout requirements including preparation of cost benefit studies or budget requirements on changes/repairs with recommendations/proposals for approval by management.
* Review and analyse technical data in support of department KPIs, highlighting trends and making recommendation reports/proposal for improvement.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree or Honours (12\+3 or equivalent).
* More than 10 years of experience in Engineering, Aeronautical.
* Degree in Aeronautical/Avionics/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering and/or holder of Aircraft Maintenance Engineering Licence for 5 years.
* Related Aircraft Engineering experience.
* Should have a minimum of 8 years in Technical Services function of which at least 5 years of experience pertaining to Emirates fleet type/aircraft systems.
* Knowledge of latest technical developments and industry trends on respective systems.
* Ability to analyse and synthesise technical information for implementation in cost effective ways.
* Excellent drafting/report writing skills.
* Demonstrable experience in managing complex tasks and decision making in a fast\-paced environment.


 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. We are seeking a Director, Sales MEA who is responsible for driving the overall sales performance of the MEA region, with a dual focus on managing a portfolio of strategic accounts and leading a team of sales professionals.
   

  

 This role combines hands\-on ownership of key B2B and B2C relationships with direct people management responsibilities, including the oversight, development, and performance management of the regional sales team. The Director Sales plays a critical role in fostering long\-term partnerships while ensuring the team delivers sustained commercial results, in line with LHW’s global philosophy and policy guidelines.
   

  

 Acting as a key contributor to both execution and strategy, the Director Sales plays a critical role in implementing team\-level sales plans and providing input into the broader regional strategy. The position requires a high level of ownership, cross\-functional collaboration, and the ability to influence stakeholders across levels.
   

  

 Time allocation:
   

  

* 40% leadership
* 30% strategy
* 30% sales involvement


 This is a full\-time position located in Dubai. We offer flexible workplace policies that allow for working remotely 3 days a week and require being in our Dubai office 2 days a week (Wednesdays and Thursdays).
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Team Leadership \& People Management
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of sales professionals, fostering a high\-performance and accountable culture
* Set and manage performance expectations, providing regular feedback and development opportunities
* Serve as a resource and escalation point for team challenges, both internal and client\-related
* Support sales team hiring, onboarding, and succession planning


 Sales Strategy and Execution
   

  

* Drive the execution of sales plans aligned with organizational objectives and member hotel needs
* Contribute to the development of segment, regional, or global strategies by offering market insights and team\-level feedback
* Monitor sales metrics and business trends to identify opportunities, adjust tactics, and optimize account coverage
* Partner with cross\-functional teams (global servicing, marketing, distribution, member relations) to align efforts and maximize impact
* Ensure strong representation and value delivery for member hotels in client engagements and partnerships


 Client Relationship Management
   

  

* Maintain and grow strategic client relationships, ensuring a high level of satisfaction, retention, and value delivery
* Support the team in managing key accounts and navigating complex negotiations or service issues
* Represent the organization and its member hotels at key industry events, meetings, and business reviews
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, identifying opportunities for growth, innovation, and collaboration


 Operations, Reporting, \& Communication
   

  

* Oversee accurate forecasting, reporting, and CRM updates, ensuring visibility into team activity and performance
* Manage team resources and budgets in alignment with strategic goals
* Facilitate regular internal communications, sharing updates, insights, and feedback across teams and leadership
* Contribute to continuous improvement of sales processes, tools, and systems


**Requirements \& Experience**
* Preferred Bachelor’s degree, ideally in Business, Sales, Marketing, or Hospitality.
* 6\+ years of progressive experience in sales, preferably in hospitality, travel, or related industries
* 2\+ years of experience leading and developing high\-performing teams
* Proven knowledge of the MEA luxury travel landscape and its key stakeholders, with an established regional network
* Proven ability to manage strategic accounts and foster long\-term client relationships
* Strong business acumen with experience in sales planning, forecasting, and performance management
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, cross\-functional, and global environment
* Ability to travel as required
* Fluent in English and Arabic


**Skills \& Abilities**
* Strategic, analytical thinker with a proven ability to develop innovative, win\-win solutions that drive value for clients, partners, and the business
* Operates effectively in fast\-paced, evolving environments; experienced in leading teams and managing shifting priorities across multiple stakeholders
* Results\-driven and self\-directed, with a consistent record of high performance, ownership, and accountability at a senior level
* Exceptional communicator with strong executive presence; adept at influencing across cross\-functional teams, client organizations, and senior leadership
* Builds lasting trust and credibility with clients, hotel partners, and internal collaborators through transparency, reliability, and expertise
* Demonstrates sound judgment and professionalism in high\-stakes, client\-facing interactions and strategic discussion
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to oversee multiple workstreams and deliverables while maintaining strategic oversight
* Strong time management and planning skills; able to set clear priorities, guide team execution, and drive results in line with business goals
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word), with the ability to develop strategic presentations and actionable reporting for internal and external stakeholders


**Benefits**
 The Leading Hotels of the World fosters a high\-performance culture and generously rewards its employees for their contributions. Here is just a preview of the benefits we offer:
   

  

* Competitive Salary and benefits package
* Up to $500 for home office setup credit
* Up to $500 travel credit that supports and encourages our employees’ passion for travel
* Opportunity to work in a diverse and dynamic environment
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible working arrangements


**About The Leading Hotels Of The World, Ltd. (LHW)**
 Comprised of more than 400 hotels in over 80 countries, LHW is the largest collection of independent luxury hotels. In 1928, 38 independent hoteliers came together to create LHW. Since then, the Company has carefully curated distinctive hotels, resorts, inns, chalets, villas, and safari camps from the snow\-capped Alps of Europe to the African veldt, to share them with adventurous souls who seek the remarkably uncommon. The LHW community is filled of exceptional individuals, united by a passion for the surprising discoveries and details that come with every experience. LHW’s collection covers the globe and promises a broad range of destinations and uncommon experiences, enhanced by LHW’s tiered guest loyalty program Leaders Club. From converted former palaces, and countryside retreats run by the same families for generations, to gleaming skyscrapers in dynamic urban centers, serene private island escapes, glamorous tented camps – and beyond – explore, find inspiration, and experience unforgettable travel moments. For more information visit: www.lhw.com, Facebook at @LeadingHotels, Twitter at @LeadingHotels and Instagram @leadinghotelsoftheworld

**SUMMARY** 




 The role requires an experienced Compliance professional with proven Risk Management and Compliance experience in financial, accounting services or trust \& fiduciary services, who will be accountable to run an efficient and effective Compliance function that ensures that all enterprise risks are monitored and addressed while enabling smooth business. The role holder will be primarily responsible to lead the compliance in the local office, with accountability to implement and maintain Amicorp’s Enterprise Risk Management framework – ensure there is an effective compliance framework, infrastructure, controls and associated policies, whereby the office complies with applicable local laws and regulations, supervisory requirements, as well as internal policies and procedures, while identifying and solving issues to ensure the smooth running of the business.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 \- Attending board meetings, advising the Board and senior management in risk management, and assisting them in assessment of risks
 



 \- Develop and implement internal risk policies and frameworks for various business units to ensure consistent risk management practices
 



 \- Collaborate with the compliance function in regulatory/compliance risk management including building second level controls (“bottom\-up” controls) and creating risk awareness; and
 



 \- Responsible for the operational risk management function within the Firm,
 



 \- Identify and evaluate risks related to the license, including market, credit, liquidity, operational, compliance, and reputational risks. Overseeing risks on margin trading, margin calls, monitoring of limits on trades.
 



 \- Participation in investment committees in all proposals.
 



 \- Conduct Stress Testing and Scenario Analysis to evaluate the firm’s resilience, continuously monitor the risk exposure and ensure that it stays within the established risk appetite and limits.
 



 \- Manage and investigate incidents related to risk management failures or breaches. Implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence and minimize impact.
 



 \- Review of quarterly reports of the MLRO and review of the adequacy of AML and compliance policies and procedures.
 



 \- Ensures client business is conducted in compliance with relevant laws, rules and regulations; Identifies and analyses business risks.
 



 \- Prepares, reviews and maintains Compliance and Risk Management policies and regulatory procedures up\-to\-date.
 



 \- Act as the main point of contact for Fund clients, identify and report any non\-compliance or suspicious activity, in accordance with anti\-money laundering legislation and regulations in a timely manner.
 



 \- Perform level of controls on compliance matters, such as transaction monitoring, client acceptance files, onboarding of Fund investors.
 



 \- Preparation for and participation in organization internal committees.
 



 \- Promotes the Compliance Department throughout the region, including ownership of compliance obligations, establishing and maintaining a compliance framework, evaluating compliance requirements, providing compliance training.
 



 \- Plays an active role in the maintenance and continuous improvement of the compliance governance framework.
 



 \- Prepares reports for the Regulatory Authorities, the Board of Directors and the Management team.
 



 \- Remains updated on developments and changes concerning relevant regulatory and money laundering laws and regulations
 



 \- Ensures adequate training of employees in relation to Compliance issues, including KYC and AML matters.
 



 \- Maintain a risk matrix for the organisation.

 \-

data.jd_text:
Are you a world\-class growth leader with a proven track record of scaling customer lifetime value (LTV) across global digital products? At Kape Technologies, we’re building the future of cybersecurity and consumer privacy through a diverse portfolio of privacy and security brands, including ExpressVPN, ExpressKeys, ExpressMailGuard, ExpressAI, Identity Defender, CyberGhost, Private Internet Access, EventVPN and Holiday.com.
   

  

 We’re looking for a VP / Director of Lifecycle \& Retention Marketing to own and scale the global lifecycle and retention engine across this portfolio as we expand into new markets and B2B opportunities. In this high\-impact role, you’ll operate at the intersection of growth, product, and data, leading a high\-performing team to shape how millions of users and businesses engage with and stay loyal to our products—while driving Kape’s evolution into a top global cybersecurity company.
   

  

 You will lead a team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle, pricing, and CRO, defining the next generation of retention through AI\-driven personalization, advanced experimentation, and world\-class customer journeys.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

 Define \& Scale the Lifecycle Growth Strategy
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle marketing strategy across all brands, with a clear mandate to maximize LTV, reduce churn, and accelerate revenue growth. Build and execute a global roadmap spanning onboarding, engagement, renewal, upsell, and winback.
   

  

 Lead a Best\-in\-Class Retention Organization
   

  

 Build, scale, and inspire a high\-performing team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle marketing, and CRO. Develop strong leadership layers, elevate talent, and foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and impact.
   

  

 Own Monetization \& Pricing Strategy
   

  

 Drive the evolution of pricing, packaging, and monetization levers across multiple products. Partner closely with Product and Finance to optimize subscription models, promotions, add\-ons, and upgrade paths that maximize long\-term customer value.
   

  

 Drive AI\-Powered CRM \& Personalization
   

  

 Leverage cutting\-edge CRM platforms and AI\-driven tools to deliver highly personalized, data\-driven customer experiences at scale. Continuously evolve segmentation, targeting, and automation strategies.
   

  

 Optimize the End\-to\-End Customer Journey (CRO \& Lifecycle)
   

  

 Own the intersection of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and lifecycle marketing, ensuring seamless, high\-converting user journeys across all touchpoints—from onboarding through renewal.
   

  

 Build a Unified Retention Ecosystem
   

  

 Partner cross\-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to create a cohesive retention and monetization engine. Align incentives, roadmaps, and execution to deliver business impact.
   

  

 Champion Data\-Driven Growth
   

  

 Establish best\-in\-class analytics and experimentation frameworks. Deeply understand and optimize key metrics including churn, resurrection, winback, upsell, renewal rates, and LTV.
   

  

 Hands\-On Leadership in a Scaling Environment

* Contribution to team development initiatives.

Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Director \- Risk,** 
 reporting to the Managing Director \- Finance in Dubai Holding Investments (DHI). The job holder will be responsible for developing and implementing a comprehensive risk management framework across DHI. This includes identifying, assessing, and mitigating financial, operational, and strategic risks to safeguard DHI’s assets, reputation, and long\-term objectives. The Director – Risk will ensure alignment of risk strategies with DHI’s investment and business goals. The role serves as a key advisor to senior leadership on risk exposure and resilience strategies.
 



  





 If you are ready to embark on a dynamic journey where your talents are valued, and your contributions make a real impact, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Risk Strategy \& Framework** 



* Develop and maintain DHI’s enterprise risk management (ERM) framework, ensuring integration with strategic and operational planning.
* Establish risk appetite and tolerance levels in alignment with DHI’s objectives and communicate these across the organization.
* Lead risk identification and assessment processes for financial, operational, regulatory, and strategic risks impacting DHI’s investments and operations.



  





**Risk Monitoring \& Reporting** 



* Implement robust risk monitoring systems and dashboards to provide timely, accurate, and actionable insights to senior leadership.
* Prepare and present comprehensive risk reports to the SVP – Finance and DHI Management, highlighting emerging risks and mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with UAE regulatory requirements and international best practices in risk governance.



  





**Operational \& Investment Risk Management** 



* Partner with investment teams to assess risks associated with new deals, capital formation, and portfolio management activities.
* Conduct scenario analysis and stress testing to evaluate the resilience of DHI’s investment portfolio under varying market conditions.
* Develop contingency plans and crisis management protocols to address potential disruptions.
* Risk Policy Development \& Compliance (in coordination with Governance \& Compliance function).
* Design and implement risk policies, procedures, and controls that align with DHI’s governance standards.
* Collaborate with Governance \& Compliance team to ensure adherence to internal and external compliance requirements.
* Maintain strong relationships with regulatory bodies and external auditors to ensure proactive compliance.








**Who we are looking for:** 



* Minimum 10–12 years of relevant experience in risk management, with at least 5 years in leadership roles within investment or financial services.
* Proven track record in developing and implementing enterprise risk frameworks in complex, multi\-asset environments.



  





**Education / Professional Certification** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field.
* Professional certifications such as FRM, PRM, or CFA preferred.



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Expertise in risk modeling, scenario analysis, and stress testing.
* Strong knowledge of regulatory frameworks (UAE and international).
* Familiarity with investment risk assessment methodologies and portfolio risk analytics.



  





**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strategic Thinking
* Results Orientation
* Problem Solving \& Decision Making
* Communication \& Influence
* Adaptability \& Flexibility
* Team Leadership



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.** 




  





**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**

* To maintain constant liaison with the Client representative for the individual’s operation and establish a good working relationship.
* To monitor ordering of all supplies/requirements both internally on site and from the supplier.

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Enterprise clients don't churn because of the product. They churn because implementation fails, adoption stalls, or they never get to the outcome they were sold.
   

  

 As Lucidya moves upmarket \- BFSI, telecom, media, retail \- the complexity of deployments grows. Onboarding a large enterprise is no longer a handoff. It's a multi\-month, multi\-stakeholder programme with real financial and reputational stakes on both sides.
   

  

 This role owns that entire delivery motion. You will build and lead the team responsible for getting customers from signed contracts to measurable value \- and keeping them there. You will own the managed services P\&L and the operational rigour that separates a world\-class implementation function from a reactive project management team.
   

  

 If you are energised by building structure in complexity, are equally comfortable in a client boardroom and a resource planning spreadsheet, and want your work to directly determine whether enterprise customers succeed \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Lead delivery end\-to\-end.**
* Execute the PMO strategy across customer onboarding, implementation, migration, and ongoing managed services \- translating strategic direction into reliable, repeatable delivery
* Ensure every project is delivered within scope, on time, and within budget \- and that CSAT and NPS reflect it
* Serve as the executive escalation point when projects hit risk. You do not wait to be told \- you see it coming
* Develop, enforce, and continuously improve standardised delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid depending on the engagement)


**Own the commercial side of services.**
* Own the deal economics for managed services \- project profitability, gross margins, and commercial accountability for the delivery function
* Forecast team capacity, manage utilisation, and optimise staffing across implementation specialists, project managers, analysts, and designers to match pipeline demand
* Work with Sales to scope SOWs accurately. Overpromising at the deal stage is a delivery problem \- you have a say in preventing it


**Build and develop the team.**
* Lead a team of Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and Programme Managers
* Mentor the team on advanced client management, negotiation, risk mitigation, and how to balance client customisation requests against platform scalability
* Build a culture of product stewardship \- the team should be Lucidya's strongest advocates for what the platform does well, not just executors of client requests


**Be the bridge between clients and the business.**
* Manage expectations on custom development by bridging communication between clients and Engineering and Product teams \- clearly, without overpromising
* Report project health, velocity, and risk to executive leadership in a way that enables fast decisions
* Partner with clients on internal capability building \- recruitment of client\-side resources, upskilling programmes, and adoption ramp plans that increase their self\-sufficiency over time
* Drive continuous improvement. Every delivery cycle should produce lessons that shorten the next one


 You are responsible for outcomes: delivery quality, margin, client satisfaction, and a team that gets better every quarter.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 7\-10\+ years of professional experience, with at least 3\-5 years leading project or delivery teams inside a SaaS environment
* You have run complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise implementations \- and you have the scars to prove it
* You are as comfortable in a C\-suite escalation conversation as you are in a weekly project status call. You know how to communicate risk without creating panic
* You understand the commercial side of services. Margin, utilisation rates, and SOW scope are not someone else's problem
* You do not manage by spreadsheet alone. You understand what motivates delivery teams and how to build a culture that takes ownership of client outcomes
* You have a working knowledge of SaaS architecture, APIs, and cloud\-based implementations \- enough to have credible technical conversations with clients and product teams
* You hold or have held a PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification. You apply methodology pragmatically, not dogmatically
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where process is still being built. You improve the system while running it


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but adaptable
* Client\-obsessed but commercially grounded
* A builder, not just a manager
* Calm under pressure \- and you set that tone for your team


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the CRO
* Case study presentation \- delivery scenario and P\&L walk\-through
* Offer

**Overview**
 AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Commercial Director to lead the commercial strategy and delivery oversight for complex projects in KSA. This role will be responsible for managing contracts, procurement, cost control, and commercial risk across multiple Design \& Build packages, including civil works, stations, systems, depots, rolling stock, and track.
   

  

 Your role

* Define and implement commercial strategies aligned with programme objectives, market conditions, and client expectations.
* Lead commercial input into procurement planning, contract structuring, and delivery models.
* Ensure commercial alignment across all packages and disciplines.


**Contract \& Claims Management**
* Lead negotiation, administration, and resolution of contracts, ensuring compliance with legal frameworks and client requirements.
* Oversee preparation and management of contract documentation, including Letters of Acceptance (LOA), change control notices, and claims analysis.
* Monitor contract performance and implement mitigation strategies for commercial risks.


**Cost Management \& Forecasting**
* Oversee cost planning, budgeting, and forecasting across all workstreams.
* Ensure adherence to cost management guidelines and promote best practices across the procurement lifecycle.
* Support change management processes, including estimating, agreement of changes, and early warning notices.

* Manage supply chain relationships and ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
* Review and validate contractor pay applications and ensure timely approvals.


**Risk \& Performance Monitoring**
* Identify and manage commercial risks across the project lifecycle.
* Maintain change management logs and ensure commercial reporting is accurate and timely.
* Establish and maintain consistent commercial procedures across all project teams.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as the senior commercial point of contact for clients, consultants, and contractors.
* Ensure transparency and trust in all commercial dealings and foster long\-term relationships.
* Coordinate with construction and project managers to resolve commercial and contractual issues.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead and mentor commercial teams, including quantity surveyors and contract managers.
* Ensure high professional standards, accuracy, and accountability across the commercial function.

* Professional accreditation (e.g., MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent).

 Rewards \& benefits

 Name of position: Clinical Project Manager\- Location: Riyadh\- Saudi Arabia
 



  





**Essential Functions and Other Job Information** 



1. Being and serve as the first point of contact to client.
2. Coordination and control over the feasibility, start\-up, clinical and site\-management activities related to a specific clinical trial within the Division.
3. Strict control over the compliance of study milestones: start, patients’ enrolment (overall study) and timelines as per the contract obligations.
4. Control over budget, issue, task, and time management of the project/s under their supervision.
5. Oversights of submission/ approval process to EC/ RA.
6. Communication with sponsors, partner CROs, physicians, third parties and regulatory authorities.
7. Manages the process of creation, approval of all essential documents developed or tailored in\-house as ICF, patient material and translated documents.
8. Responsible for distribution within the team of final approved version of all essential documents (Protocol, IB, CRF, ICF, etc.).
9. Initiate qualification and approval, ongoing management, oversight and dealing with all third parties involved in the study; complete re\-assessment activities.
10. Develops and communicates all study specific plans as PMP, monitoring plan, TMF maintenance plan, communication plan, quality plan, project risk matrix (if applicable) as well as any other study\-specific instructions and guidelines.

12. Control over all logistic procedures related to the study.
13. Identify changes, work with team members to quantify financial/ time impact and communicate those changes to appropriate personnel.
14. Ensures the contracting process, when required.
15. Timely coverage of all assigned trainings.
16. Adheres to the rules and regulations of ICH\-GCP and other regulatory and ethical guidelines and data protection regulations.
17. Coordinates activities between different stakeholders and determine interim study time points.
18. Providing any requested internal progress reports and completion of the relevant files.
19. Preparation and conducting of Investigator Meetings in close collaboration with the client.
20. Collaboration with internal/ external auditors, co\-monitors, or regulatory inspectors in review of files and patient data.
21. Executes any activities in compliance with applicable SOPs, instructions, and principles.
22. Development and update of company SOPs and policies in close collaboration with Management.
23. Support Business Development activities in terms of meetings and budget development as applicable.

 • University degree with life science background or equivalent and relevant formal academic/ vocational
 



 qualification.
 



 • At least 6 years of experience in the field of clinical research; Managing at least 5 Interventional CT.
 



  





**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** 




 • Advanced knowledge of GCP guideline and all applicable clinical research requirements
 



 • Proficiency in English language
 



 • Leadership and good sense of teamwork
 



 • Excellent analytical, organizational, negotiation and decision\-making skills
 



 • Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to
 



 and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
 



 • Good time management and multitasking skills to coordinate several issues simultaneously.
 



 • Solid interpersonal skills
 



 • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in\-house and off\-the\-shelf.
 



 • Appropriate MS Office Skills
 



 • May interact with others, relating and gathering sensitive information. Interaction includes diverse
 



 groups.
 



 • Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions based on task prioritization.
 



 • Ability to perform under stress.
 



 • Regular and consistent attendance
 



  





**Working Conditions and Environment** 




 • Work is performed in an office or clinical environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
 



 • Often travels/ drives to site locations. Frequent travel both domestic and international.
 



  





**The Company Offer:** 




 \- Job\-specific training
 



 \- Work for successful international company, excellent career development opportunity in a perspective professional field
 



 \- Very competitive remuneration package
 



 \- Additional benefits related to work performance.
 



  





**Website** 




 https://pdc\-cro.com
 



  





 The Assigned Country: Saudi Arabia
 



  





**Only short\-listed candidates will be contacted for interviews.** 




  





 By submitting your application, you agree that your personal data will be processed by PDC in accordance with the applicable Data Protection Law and in strictly keeping your confidentiality.

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 At Lucidya, closing a deal is the beginning of the work \- not the end of it. Enterprise clients come with complex requirements, multiple stakeholders, and zero tolerance for delivery that doesn't match what was promised.
   

  

 This role sits at the centre of that delivery. You will be the operational backbone that keeps projects on track, stakeholders aligned, and risks visible before they become problems. You will work across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal \- not as a coordinator, but as the person who holds the whole picture and makes sure every part of the business is moving in the same direction.
   

  

 If you are the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when things are vague, who builds structure because it actually helps, and who takes personal ownership of whether a project lands well \- this role is for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Own delivery from pre\-RFP to go\-live.**
* Lead pre\-RFP alignment sessions to validate scope, timeline, resource availability, and budget assumptions before any commitment is made
* Establish and enforce a handover framework from RFP to delivery \- with clear ownership and traceability at every stage of the project lifecycle
* Ensure every project proposal goes through cross\-functional validation (Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance) before it goes out the door
* Review vendor and subcontractor arrangements for procurement compliance and operational readiness


**Run governance like it matters \- because it does.**
* Design and maintain project governance frameworks that define accountability, escalation paths, and decision\-making checkpoints
* Keep a live project and risk register covering progress, dependencies, financial exposure, and compliance risks
* Maintain executive dashboards and PMO reports that give leadership real visibility \- not a sanitised summary
* Enforce stage gates and approval processes before any contractual, financial, or delivery commitment is made
* Run post\-implementation reviews that actually produce lessons, not just documentation


**Keep every part of the business aligned.**
* Serve as the central coordination point across Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Finance, Legal, and Delivery
* Lead project initiation, steering, and review meetings \- and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates
* Maintain consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders through dashboards, executive summaries, and progress reports that people actually read
* Facilitate procurement and vendor coordination, ensuring external partners meet internal standards and regulatory requirements


**Manage third\-party and vendor risk.**
* Oversee vendor and third\-party onboarding governance \- tools, processors, and contractors must meet data protection and regulatory standards before they touch a project
* Maintain a Third\-Party Risk Register tracking compliance obligations, privacy safeguards, and mitigation activities
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Data Privacy on risk assessments, incident responses, and breach reporting related to external partners


**Bring the same rigour to internal programmes.**
* Extend the PM framework beyond client projects to internal strategic initiatives \- process transformation, system rollouts, product programmes
* Track progress against annual strategic objectives and KPIs, and report it clearly to leadership
* Develop and maintain standardised PM tools, templates, and procedures that the wider team can actually use


 You are responsible for outcomes: projects that land on time, within budget, and without surprises.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 5\+ years in project or programme management, preferably in SaaS or enterprise technology. You have managed complex, multi\-workstream projects and you know what good governance looks like in practice
* You are comfortable holding multiple complex projects simultaneously without dropping the thread on any of them
* You think in terms of risk before others see it. You flag early, escalate when you should, and never let a problem fester because it was uncomfortable to raise
* You have real financial acumen \- cost modelling, budget tracking, and ROI analysis are not tasks you hand off
* You can influence without authority. You work across functions where you do not control the resources, and you still get things done
* Your communication is clear, structured, and calibrated to the audience \- whether that is an engineer, a client, or a CEO
* You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification. You apply methodology pragmatically \- the framework serves the project, not the other way around
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where not everything is defined. You build the structure and improve it as you go


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but not rigid
* Proactive, not reactive
* Calm when it gets complicated \- and it will get complicated
* Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the Head of Services
* Case study presentation \- project governance and risk scenario
* Offer

**Position\- MEP Project Manager**
**Location\- Riyadh\- Saudi Arabia**
**Role:**
 The Project Manager is responsible for delivering and leading the assigned project. This includes review of handover documentation from Tender Team, Project Kick\-off, planning, executing, controlling, monitoring and closing out the project, while managing risks, opportunities, commercial management, timelines, resources and the entire scope of the project. The Project Manager is required to act as the primary focal point of contact between JEG Senior Management, the Client, Consultants and the JEG Project Delivery Team ensuring the desired project objectives are delivered meeting all set project objectives
   

  

**Project Roles And Responsibilities**
* Direct line of report Regional Projects Director
* Critique tender documentation / Pre\-Construction project handover documentation, identify project risks and opportunities with Project Leads
* Manages the expectations of project leadership and stakeholders throughout the project.
* Ensures all departments are complying with all standard JEG SOP’s
* Responsible for managing the execution of all project milestones/deliverables. Establish and monitor program and project controls KPI's.
* Acts as a primary day to day liaison to the client project leadership teams and project execution partners.
* Identifies and resolve disputes quickly and reasonably with Project Stakeholders.
* Develops and maintains a comprehensive project plan, in keeping with the size and complexity as mutually agreed upon by the JEG organization SOP and the Project Director.
* Provides leadership and actively manages the project team resources within the confines of the project, identifying any deficiencies to the Project Director.
* Ensure that the health and safety requirements are provided in coordination with HSE Manager and that they comply with JEG HSE requirements and authorities’ regulations. Ensure regular audits are carried out for EHS compliance and any remedial actions are implemented in coordination with the HSE Manager.
* Manages detailed project planning documentation in conjunction with the Project Controls Engineer (Execution Plans, Risk Mgmt. Log, Status Reports, Schedule Reports, Progress Reports), these reports shall be prepared in accordance with Regional JEG Standardized Reporting Template formats.
* Manages detailed Project Budget Reports detailing Preliminaries, Procurement, indirect and direct staff, Subcontractors and overheads / Cost forecasts in conjunction with the QS / Project Controls Engineer with consultation of Project Director and Commercial Director
* Actively manages, communicates and mitigates project risks and issues and escalates when necessary


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Time served apprenticeship an advantage.
* Minimum 10 years work experience on construction projects / Minimum 3 years as a Project Manager
* Qualifications commensurate with position:
* Role applicable degree from a reputed university / Trade Qualifications NVQ, etc.
* Experience in Data Centre Projects.
* Competent in the use of PC applications (Microsoft Office suit or equivalent)
* MEP background

**Job Summary**
 The Project Director is responsible for the overall leadership and delivery of large\-scale data centre projects in Saudi Arabia within a general contracting environment. The role has full accountability for project performance, including safety, programme, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, local authority requirements, and contractual obligations. Working closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders, the Project Director builds, develops and leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver mission\-critical data centre facilities to the highest standards, while managing local supply chains, Saudization requirements, and fast\-track project demands in the KSA market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery:**
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, mission\-critical data centre project from mobilisation through commissioning and handover.
* Take full responsibility for project performance, including programme, cost control, quality, safety, and risk management.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.
* Lead project governance, reporting, and decision\-making at senior and client levels.
* Appointment of individuals to key project positions.
* Work across company functional departments to engage support for on time delivery.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Act as the primary senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring confidence in delivery and responsiveness.
* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.


**Commercial \& Contractual Oversight:**
* Oversee commercial strategy in collaboration with commercial team.
* Ensure effective cost control, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Review and approve major subcontract packages, procurement strategies, and commercial decisions.
* Manage risk, claims, and dispute avoidance/resolution.


**Team \& Resource Management:**
* Build, Lead, mentor, and develop project management, engineering, construction, and support teams.
* Ensure appropriate resourcing, capability, and succession planning for project delivery.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, and performance excellence.


**Programme, Quality \& Safety:**
* Ensure robust planning and programme controls are in place to meet critical data centre milestones.
* Drive best\-in\-class quality assurance and control processes aligned with data centre standards.
* Champion health, safety, and environmental excellence across all project activities.


**Pre\-Construction \& Business Support:**
* Support pre\-construction, tendering, and bid teams with construction methodology, programme input, and risk reviews.
* Contribute to value engineering, buildability reviews, and logistics planning.
* Support business development efforts related to data centre opportunities where required.


**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years’ experience in construction delivery, with significant experience as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale data centre projects within a General Contracting / Main Contractor environment.
* Middle East \& Saudi Arabia experience, including knowledge of local regulations and practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing large, multi\-disciplinary teams and major subcontractors.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and risk management expertise.


**Key Competencies**
* Executive\-level project leadership
* Data centre construction expertise (mission\-critical environments)
* Client and stakeholder management
* Commercial and contractual acumen
* Programme and risk management
* Decision\-making under pressure
* Safety and quality leadership


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong leadership presence and credibility at client and executive level.
* Highly organised, decisive, and results\-driven.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-cultural teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, high\-risk, mission\-critical environments.

**Company Description**
 At QIMA, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust.
   

  

 Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
   

  

 We combine on\-the\-ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data.
   

  

 What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
   

  

 Our Consumer Products Division is dedicated to helping brands, retailers and manufacturers worldwide deliver safe, quality and ethically made products to their consumers. Every day at work, our inspectors, auditors, lab techs, and certification specialists use their expertise to help safeguard the products you use every day in your home: from clothes and footwear to toys and baby products, to electronics, appliances, and furniture.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Role in Brief**
 The Manager \- Client Service \& Global Program will manage the Client Services and Program Department, maintaining a high level of service quality, understanding client needs, and developing strong client relationships, while ensuring compliance with regulatory programs such as SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT. This role will report directly to the Head of Certification Unit working as part of our Client Service \& Program team.
   

  

 The purpose of QIMA’s Client Service \& Program team is to deliver seamless certification experience to our clients by managing key programs and ensuring the highest standards of client satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Supervise the Program Management \& Client Service Team and ensure continuous monitoring of service quality and operational efficiency.
* Manage and maintain client relationships to enhance the customer service experience, ensuring service quality and efficient operations.
* Identify and seek further business opportunities while developing relationships with new clients.
* Oversee client’s programs and maintain understanding of regulatory program requirements including SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT.
* Support the Sales Team to resolve client enquiries and problems with consistency and accuracy.
* Handle ad\-hoc assignments as required.
* Champion an AI\-first mindset by promoting the use of AI tools and technologies in day\-to\-day operations and encouraging experimentation and adoption of AI\-driven solutions to improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and elevate service quality.


**Qualifications**
**To succeed in this role, you have:**
* Diploma or degree holder in any discipline; Electrical, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering background is a plus.
* Fluent in written and spoken English; Chinese or Arabic speaking is an advantage and preferable.
* 5\+ years of working experience in operations and client service within a certification body; experience in testing laboratory management and in\-depth technical knowledge are an advantage.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in managing a team, customer service, and client management.
* Self\-initiated, independent, and a good team player.
* 5\+ years of total experience; experience in certification bodies with team management responsibilities is highly valued.
* Familiarity with regulatory programs such as SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT is a strong advantage.
* A genuine enthusiasm for Artificial Intelligence and its practical applications in operations, quality control, or client management; experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity and decision\-making is a strong plus.


**Additional Information**
 Because our differences make the difference, at QIMA we are proud to promote inclusive diversity and equal opportunities! Our policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
   

  

*QIMA recognizes and recruits all its talents.*

**Role Summary**
 The Program Director provides executive\-level leadership and strategic oversight across all LDIP PMCM phases. As the primary point of accountability, the incumbent ensures that all PMCM services are delivered to the highest professional standards, on time, and in full compliance with the requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable national and international standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Leadership \& Program Governance
* Serve as the ultimate professional authority and single point of accountability for PMCM delivery across all phases and sites
* Define and implement the Program Execution Strategy, governance framework, and management methodology; provide executive decision\-making on all scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk matters
* Direct the PMCM team across all disciplines — program management, design, controls, commercial, QHSE, risk, and document control — ensuring consistent performance and alignment
* Design Management \& Procurement (Phase A \& B)
* Oversee PMCM design management across DMP and pre\-construction phases, ensuring Lead Developer outputs comply with LDIP design intent, program objectives, target zoning, plot ratios, and standards
* Direct Value Engineering sessions, procurement strategy development, and tendering processes in compliance with Ministry of Finance regulations
* Construction Supervision \& Contract Administration (Phase C)
* Lead management and supervision of Lead Developer entities across all sites through construction, enforcing compliance with the Terms of Engagement, schedules, regulatory requirements, and quality standards
* Oversee contract administration including payment certification, change order management, claims evaluation, and stakeholder interface coordination with government authorities and utility providers
* Project Controls \& Reporting
* Establish and maintain the Project Controls framework covering schedule, cost, quality, and risk; ensure EVM, KPI tracking, and risk mitigation are implemented consistently across the program
* 
* Review and approve all major deliverables including monthly progress reports, cost reports, risk registers, and schedule updates; provide timely executive briefings and exception reports
* QHSE, Closeout \& Team Management
* Champion a zero\-incident safety culture; direct the Risk Management framework; ensure ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards are maintained across all Developer\-facing operations
* Lead the closeout phase through snagging, commissioning, handover documentation, and the Final Close\-Out Report; ensure all PMCM staff are mobilized within 30 days of written request


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Over 20 years of relevant professional experience; over 12 years in a Project Director or equivalent senior management role
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* Membership of a recognized Chartered or Professional Engineering Institution
* Demonstrated track record directing large\-scale land development, infrastructure, or urban development programs, ideally in the GCC/KSA context
* International / Western Qualifications and Experience

**Job Description**
 What if you could shape a career as unique as you?
   

  

 At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.
   

  

 As a
 **Project Manager** 
 you support the Senior Project Manager and Project Director in leading the planning, execution, and delivery of complex master planning projects. You will support all aspects of the project, including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and stakeholder management, ensuring that the project is completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards to the successful delivery of master plans. This role requires a strong understanding of urban development principles and the ability to navigate complex regulatory environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Detailed Key Responsibilities**
* Project Leadership \& Lifecycle Management
* End\-to\-End Delivery: Lead the tactical execution of Master Planning projects from inception through to delivery.
* Workstream Integration: Synchronize multi\-disciplinary workstreams—including infrastructure, sustainability, landscape architecture, and transport planning—to ensure a unified project output.
* Revenue Management \& Performance Monitoring: Implement and oversee Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) regarding schedule adherence, budget burn rates, and technical quality standards.
* Governance \& Change Control
* Project Reporting \& Performance Management: Lead the preparation and delivery of high\-quality weekly and monthly progress reports (MPRs) for clients, providing clear updates on programme status, key milestones, risks, resource utilisation, commercial performance, and upcoming look\-ahead activities.
* Scope Management: Rigorously monitor project boundaries; identify, document, and manage "scope creep" to ensure commercial viability.
* Change Protocol: Execute formal Change Requests for variations in schedule or budget, conducting impact assessments before escalating for Senior Management approval.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify project risks (regulatory, environmental, or financial) and develop robust mitigation strategies to prevent delivery delays.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication
* Primary Point of Contact: Act as the central liaison for clients, government authorities, utility providers, and contractors, ensuring transparency and trust.
* Conflict Resolution: Mediate technical or contractual disputes between stakeholders, leveraging professional diplomacy to maintain project momentum.
* Reporting Excellence: Author and present comprehensive monthly progress reports, dashboard updates, and executive briefings for internal leadership and external client boards.
* Quality Assurance \& Documentation
* Technical Compliance: Ensure all deliverables align with local planning regulations, international best practices, and the specific sustainability mandates of the project – by working with the technical leads of the project.
* Document Control: Oversee a rigorous documentation environment, ensuring all deliverables, data requests, email requests and stakeholder approvals are audited and archived correctly.
* Schedule Management: Develop and maintain detailed Project Plans using MS Project or Primavera P6\. Utilize Critical Path Methodology (CPM) to identify and mitigate potential delays.


**Qualifications**
* Academic Foundation: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Management or Information Technology.
* Professional Experience: A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in project management for management consultancies or similar. Experience of project management within large\-scale master planning or urban infrastructure is desired.
* Project Methodology: Advanced proficiency in structured frameworks such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile, or Waterfall.
* Software Command: Expert\-level mastery of Microsoft Project, PowerPoint, Excel and Word. Primavera P6 is desirable.
+ Design Coordination: Familiarity with InDesign.
+ Data/Commercial: Advanced Excel (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, financial modelling)

* Essential Behavioural Competencies
* Self\-Starter \& Proactive Ownership: Takes initiative, thinks ahead, identifies risks and opportunities early, and drives actions forward without the need for close supervision or constant direction.
* Workload Management \& Accountability: Effectively manages own priorities, remains organised under pressure, and can independently balance multiple tasks and deadlines with minimal guidance.
* Team Contribution \& Support: Works collaboratively as part of the wider team, builds strong internal relationships, and actively supports colleagues by sharing workload and contributing where needed.
* Senior PM Support \& Added Capacity: Provides reliable support to the Senior Project Manager by taking ownership of delegated responsibilities, reducing pressure on senior leadership, and stepping in to manage additional tasks during peak periods.
* Client \& Stakeholder Relationship Building: Builds trusted, professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams through clear communication and dependable delivery.
* PMO \& Project Controls Capability: Able to undertake all aspects of PMO support, including reporting, governance, programme coordination, document control, action tracking, and maintaining project controls.
* Financial Management \& Forecasting: Competent in managing project financials, including monitoring time charged, tracking spend, reviewing budgets, and maintaining accurate cost forecasts.
* Resilience \& Commitment: Comfortable working in demanding, fast\-paced environments, including longer days or additional hours when required to meet project milestones and business needs.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Responds positively to changing priorities, urgent issues, and evolving project requirements while maintaining a high standard of delivery.
* Communication: Exceptional command of written and spoken English. Ability to present complex data in a visually compelling and concise manner. Arabic proficiency is desirable.
* KSA Client Environment Experience: Good understanding of client expectations, business culture, and consultant standards when operating in Saudi Arabia.
* Certification: Active PMP (Project Management Professional) or Chartered Planner (RTPI/AICP/MRICS) status is highly desirable.
* Specialized Knowledge: Experience with KSA Giga\-projects is a significant advantage.
* Advanced Analytics: Use of Power BI and other analytical tools.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security \& Environmental; Energy; Mining \& Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start\-up and operations.
   

  

 Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments . They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report .
   

  

**Project Overview**
 The Ar Rjum Project comprises a green field gold project with three open pit mining operations with associated waste dumps and ore stockpile, a processing plant, tailings management facilities, and supporting infrastructure including water supply, power supply, maintenance facilities, offices, temporary and permanent accommodation village.
   

  

 The Project is situated within the Central Arabian Gold Region, approximately 200 km north\-east of Taif towards Riyadh and about 26 km South of Al Mouwayh, which is a small town situated on the Jeddah \- Riyadh highway.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The project controls manager oversees cost estimating, analysis, and control activities for one or more delivery teams. Supervises schedule development, maintenance, monitoring, impact identification, and recovery plan development activities. Supervises the preparation and presentation of estimates. Supports project organizational and administrative activities. Identifies, examines, and provides innovative solutions to cost engineering and planning/scheduling problems. Provides generally non\-routine cost engineering/planning and scheduling guidance to projects.
   

  

 Reports to and receives technical guidance and operational supervision from designated supervisory personnel. Provides technical and operational direction to assigned personnel. Ensures work is completed as scheduled. Maintains relationships with the Project Manager and project personnel, particularly individual discipline group leaders and engineers. Continuing contacts with Project Manager, project team members, and working and supervisory level personnel of other departments.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Provides comments and recommendations for planning and scheduling/cost engineering requirements relative to staffing and project control. Prepares detailed staffing plans for planning and scheduling/cost engineering activities
* Reviews or assists in reviewing proposal provisions related to schedule/cost engineering and material control, and develops supporting data for contract negotiations.
* Identifies cost trends and schedule impacts for management attention.
* Interfaces with designated Bechtel management and client counterparts for specific planning and schedule tasks/cost presentations.
* Prepares and presents cost engineering/estimating/planning and scheduling information to management/client.
* Coordinates information input into specific studies. Responsible for integration of activities and total work scope identification. Evaluates study results and recommends conclusions for project team consideration and discussion.
* Coordinates and establishes scoping requirements for the overall cost estimate by discipline or other specialty, and coordinates the timely, systematic, and complete acquisition of scope definition and related data. Reviews design scope criteria and quantities for completeness and reasonableness, and coordinates with the project to develop additional estimating bases when information is incomplete. Establishes the conceptual scope of estimates and studies when definition is not available.
* Plans, coordinates, and establishes level of quantification appropriate to the objectives of the effort and to the level of scope definition for each discipline or specialty, and designates reference job(s) for source data and/or reconciliations of quantities. Reviews quantities and their completeness and reasonableness.
* Supervises the timely and competent preparation of cost estimates. Establishes format and content of summaries and reconciliations, including segregation of cost according to level of confidence and identification of areas of risk.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
* 25 years of total experience, Minimum 20 years professional experience in project controls with emphasis on cost and project estimating.


**Required Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience in performing, monitoring, and reviewing planning and scheduling functions, including schedule development, control, and analysis, and cost engineering functions, including cost estimating, cost control, financial reporting systems, and cost analysis, in the field and the home office.
* Knowledge of supervision, personnel administration, and training of technical and nontechnical personnel.
* Demonstrated ability to plan, organize, direct, perform, review, and present cost engineering and cost estimating products. This includes planning and scheduling products independently with minimal supervision using a high level of professional judgment and knowledge related to technical planning and scheduling skills and engineering design and construction practices.
* Skilled in oral and written communication.
* Demonstrates an advanced level of understanding of general Project Controls technical skills.
* Advanced level of knowledge of engineering, procurement, contracts, construction, and startup work processes, as performed by Bechtel.
* Knowledge of engineering and construction management customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience.

 For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth.  WSP is seeking an experienced Project Manager to play a pivotal role in driving both work winning and operational delivery across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This strategic role brings together business development and project execution, contributing directly to the organisation’s growth and long term success in the region.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying and securing new opportunities, building and maintaining strong client relationships, and ensuring the effective mobilisation and delivery of projects from award through to completion.
   

  

 As a key driver of growth and delivery performance, the Project Manager will lead capture strategies and tender submissions for major public and private sector clients, while maintaining oversight of project execution, commercial performance, and delivery outcomes post award.
   

  

**Key requirements include:**
* Strong commercial acumen and contractual awareness.
* In\-depth knowledge of the Saudi construction market.
* Proven experience in winning and delivering major projects.
* Ability to operate strategically while retaining hands on delivery oversight.


 This role offers the opportunity to work on high profile projects while playing a central role in shaping the organisation’s continued growth across Saudi Arabia.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Work Winning / Business Development (Pre\-Contract)**
* Lead the full bid lifecycle: EOI, prequalification, tender review, proposal strategy, preparation, and submission.
* Develop and execute capture strategies for key clients including ministries, PIF entities, and major private developers.
* Review tender documents in detail to identify scope gaps, commercial risks, pricing exposure, and contractual obligations.
* Lead the development of pricing strategies aligned with market conditions, competitive positioning, and company margin targets.
* Perform cost benchmarking against historical data and current market rates.
* Lead internal pricing reviews and sign\-off meetings with senior management.
* Participate in commercial negotiations, clarifications, and value engineering discussions with clients.
* Maintain a bid cost database and lessons\-learned register to improve future pricing accuracy and win rates.
* Support contract finalization to ensure alignment between tender pricing assumptions and awarded scope


**Project Operations (Post\-Contract)**
* Lead project mobilization in accordance with contractual scope, deliverables, and agreed commercial terms.
* Ensure thorough contract review upon award to validate scope boundaries, pricing assumptions, exclusions, and risk allocation.
* Administer contracts in line with contract conditions, ensuring compliance with all contractual obligations.
* Establish project execution plans, cost baselines and resource deployment forecasts.
* Oversee project P\&L performance, including revenue recognition, gross margin protection, and cost control.
* Update cost\-to\-complete each month for assigned projects.
* Manage invoicing processes, ensuring timely submission, certification, and collection in coordination with finance.
* Lead commercial management of variations, scope changes, and additional services.
* Identify and proactively manage commercial risks, claims exposure, and dispute matters.
* Ensure proper documentation of correspondence, instructions, approvals, and change records to protect contractual position.
* Manage subconsultant agreements including scope definition, performance monitoring, certification of payments, and back\-to\-back commercial alignment.
* Conduct regular project performance reviews with senior management.
* Close out projects commercially and contractually, including final account settlement and lessons\-learned documentation.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical), Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related discipline.
* PMP certification or equivalent preferred.
* Minimum 8 years of experience within engineering consultancy or construction management.
* Proven experience in both bid management and project delivery in Saudi Arabia.
* Good knowledge of Saudi construction industry, clients and procurement processes.
* Experience working on major infrastructure, mixed\-use, or giga\-projects.
* Excellent communications and negotiation skills.
* Fluency in English required; Arabic strongly preferred.


**Competencies**
* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen.
* Leadership capabilities.
* Strong analytical and risk management skills.
* High level of professionalism and client\-facing confidence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

 Lead the planning and execution of all event operations and site\-wide delivery at Cultural and Heritage program, ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality delivery of cultural programming, guest experience, and large\-scale event operations in alignment with asset objectives
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
