data.jd_text:
**talabat** 
 is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 talabat is the leading food and Q\-commerce marketplace in Qatar, delivering food, groceries \& more to thousands of customers on a daily basis. We are seeking a Managing Director (MD) for Qatar who excels in dynamic, fast paced environments, with a knack for problem solving. The MD of Qatar should have an entrepreneurial, strategic mindset, with a mission to unlock new avenues of growth for talabat, whether by expanding our food business, further scaling our Q\-commerce business, or growing our ecosystem products (i.e. Subscription, Rewards, Fintech).
   

  

 The MD of Qatar will be tasked to elevate the performance of the existing organisation and simplify its operating model, maximising synergies between functions \& verticals. Team leadership and culture building are key skill sets needed to thrive in this role. The MD of Qatar will be a senior member of the talabat Management team, and will be the ultimate owner of the full P\&L (on a strategic, tactical, and day to day level).
   

  

**What's On Your Plate?**
**Role**
 In this role, you will represent the local voice to regional teams, while working closely with the Chief International Officer (CIO) and other C\-level executives to:
   

  

* Shape a seamless, effective operating model, across all business verticals (food \& Q\-commerce).
* Maximize synergies across teams, programs and verticals, and build a culture of growth.
* Define quarterly OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) and priorities for Qatar team.
* Act as the key 'customer' for the Product and Technology organization, collaborating to set priorities and solve problems.
* You will have full ownership of performance and P\&L, which includes:
+ Designing and executing the strategy and business plan for talabat in Qatar.
+ Preparing and negotiating annual budgets, ensuring EBITDA targets are met on a monthly, quarterly \& annual basis, and recommending additional investments if necessary.
+ Leading a large, diverse team across multiple programs and verticals.
+ Overseeing day\-to\-day operations in key functions such as logistics, marketing, sales, performance and partnerships, while representing the company in legal matters, public relations, communications, and government relations.
+ Identifying and analyzing opportunities for accelerated growth across various programs and verticals.
+ Leveraging data to drive decision making, whether to address day\-to\-day problems, or tackle long term opportunities.
+ Launching local, regional, and global transformational programs, and driving continuous improvement initiatives that can scale globally.


**Qualifications**
 As the ideal candidate, you will have a proven track record in driving successful operations, and implementing core strategies that impact both top\-line and bottom\-line results, preferably in leadership positions. With experience in uncovering problems and designing solutions for dynamic and fast\-paced businesses, you are passionate about your work and adept at navigating complex systems daily to deliver business impact.

**Primary Objective**
 The Project Engineering Manager is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering framework for project execution, ensuring the effective delivery of multi\-disciplinary engineering and design activities across our offshore projects in Energy and hydrocarbon sectors.
   

  

**Specific Accountabilities**
**Engineering Leadership \& Execution**
* Establish and implement the project engineering execution framework, including procedures, deliverables, workflows, and interface management.
* Lead and coordinate multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across Feasibility/ Concept, FEED and Detailed Design phases.
* Direct the preparation and quality of engineering deliverables, ensuring alignment with scope, standards, and schedule requirements.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant design output, meeting customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Review and approve engineering execution strategies, project organization structures, and discipline responsibilities.
* Prepare and implement the Engineering management Plan on projects and ensure discipline schedules/budgets include safety and sustainability activities for the asset lifecycle.
* Manage technical Value Improvement Practices (VIPs) \- technology selection, value engineering, energy optimization, RAM, etc.


**Cross\-Discipline Coordination \& Interface Management**
* Provide overall integration across engineering disciplines, ensuring effective sequencing and interface management.
* Establish and maintain engineering coordination procedures with internal teams, licensors, contractors, and stakeholders.
* Oversee and manage interfaces between engineering, procurement, construction, and third\-party contractors.
* Ensure structured communication and resolution of technical queries and inter\-disciplinary conflicts.


**Technical Governance \& Quality Assurance**
* Ensure engineering activities comply with Worley standards, international codes, and customer specifications
* Must ensure maintaining engineering quality assurance processes, including document control, review cycles, and approval timelines.
* Lead the review and approval of key engineering documents, ensuring compliance with HSSEQ, operability, maintainability, and technical integrity requirements.
* Must ensure and participate in design reviews, safety studies, and technical assurance activities.
* Ensure required Technical Peer Reviews (TPRs) are planned, scheduled, and budgeted; proactively engage Location Director of Engineering when needed.


**Project Management \& Delivery**
* Overall key technical interface with customer management teams.
* Support the safe, on\-time, and within\-budget delivery of engineering scope across all project phases.
* Monitor engineering progress against schedule, budget, and deliverable milestones, identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans.
* Provide technical and commercial input to optimize design solutions and manage project risks.
* Ensure alignment between engineering outputs and project controls (cost, schedule, procurement needs).
* Maintain engineering registers for assumptions, holds, technical queries, deviations, key document changes, and SEAL decisions.


**HSSEQ \& Compliance**
* Champion Health, Safety, Security, Environment, and Quality culture within engineering activities.
* Ensure designs incorporate safe, sustainable, and environmentally compliant solutions.
* Ensure compliance with local and international regulatory frameworks and standards.


**Team Leadership \& Capability**
* Lead, mentor, and develop multi\-location engineering teams, ensuring effective resource allocation and competency.
* Ensure teams are appropriately staffed and aligned with project requirements.
* Foster collaboration across disciplines, offices, and stakeholders.
* Capture and implement lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Education**
* Full\-Time Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline of Engineering from an accredited University.
* Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status or undertaking the same will be an advantage.
* MME (Ministry of Municipality and Environment) engineering accreditation is a mandatory requirement. Candidates not holding this accreditation must be willing to achieve this within the probationary period.


**Job Specific Knowledge , Experience \& Competencies**
* Significant experience in oil \& gas, petrochemical, or energy sector projects.
* Must have proven experience as Project Engineering Manager / Engineering Manager on Pre\-FEED, FEED and Detailed Engineering projects during the last five years.
* Strong exposure to multi\-disciplinary engineering and global delivery teams.


**Technical \& Functional Competencies**
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, execution planning, and design assurance.
* Extensive knowledge of cross\-discipline integration, interfaces, and sequencing.
* Experience in engineering deliverables, specifications, and design review processes.
* Solid understanding of project lifecycle phases (Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, EPC).
* Familiarity with industry standards and customer specifications.
* Experience in risk management, change management, and technical decision\-making.


**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong leadership capability with ability to manage diverse, multi\-location teams.
* Effective communicator with the ability to influence technical and commercial decisions.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to manage complexity and conflicting priorities.
* High level of planning, organization, and execution discipline.
* Ability to operate in fast\-paced, multi\-project environments.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.jd_text:
**Role Summary**
 We are hiring a Senior IT Project Manager to lead complex, multi\-stream IT programs at the client's Information Systems Department. The role engages C\-level stakeholders, governs multi\-year strategic initiatives, and owns programmatic delivery across infrastructure, applications, security, and digital transformation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and govern multi\-stream IT programs with consolidated budgets above QAR 20M.
* Own portfolio\-level risk and dependency management across concurrent projects.
* Engage end\-client C\-level stakeholders (Director, Manager\-ISD level) and relevant Qatar government bodies and vendors.
* Define and govern program\-level financial models, benefits realisation, and value tracking.
* Build and lead matrixed delivery teams of 20\+ resources.
* Negotiate and govern major vendor contracts and SLAs.
* Lead steering committees and program governance forums.
* Drive strategic initiatives end\-to\-end — IT modernisation, cloud migration, application portfolio rationalisation, security uplift programs.
* Coach and mentor IT Project Managers within the department.
* Lead change management and organisational adoption strategies.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Business; Master's strongly preferred.
* 12\+ years in IT project / program management with 5\+ at senior / program level.
* 5\+ years GCC region experience, ideally including Qatar.
* PMP certification mandatory; PgMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, or PMI\-RMP strongly preferred.
* Proven track record delivering IT programs valued above QAR 20M with measurable business outcomes.
* Strong financial acumen — multi\-year budget planning, forecasting, EVM.
* Native or fluent Arabic AND professional English — preferred (not mandatory).


**Preferred / Nice To Have**
* PgMP (Program Management Professional).
* ITIL v4 Strategic Leader.
* Agile/SAFe certifications.
* Prior leadership of digital transformation programs in Qatar government.
* TOGAF or other architectural awareness.
* Direct experience with Qatar government procurement and tendering processes.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The role will act as the senior onsite engagement lead for the client, governing end\-to\-end delivery, operational readiness, release management, platform stability, AI operations, and managed services execution across multiple enterprise platforms.
   

  

 The role is responsible for designing, launching, and scaling enterprise grade DataOps, MLOps, AI operations, CI/CD, application support, and managed services capabilities from the ground up. This includes enabling governance frameworks, operational standards, release governance processes, service management models, operational KPIs, support structures, and scalable delivery capabilities.
   

  

 In addition, the role plays a key leadership function in stakeholder management, capability development, business growth, and long\-term service expansion. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong leadership across Data \& AI delivery, production operations, organizational capability building, and executive stakeholder engagement within complex multi\-vendor environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Enterprise Platform Delivery \& Operations Leadership
* Own enterprise delivery and operational governance across multiple data platforms.
* Lead production readiness, hypercare governance, release management, operational acceptance, and transition into managed services.
* Govern enterprise platform lifecycle management including environment management, deployment governance, rollback planning, and operational stabilization.
* Ensure delivery alignment with strategic business objectives, roadmap priorities, operational timelines, and release schedules.
* Drive operational scalability, resiliency, observability, monitoring, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* DataOps, MLOps \& AI Operations
* Establish and scale enterprise\-grade DataOps, MLOps, CI/CD, and AI operations frameworks.
* Define operational standards for model deployment, monitoring, retraining coordination, drift management, inference operations, and AI governance controls.
* Govern AI operational readiness and support processes for enterprise AI use cases across multiple production platforms.
* Standardize release management, deployment automation, testing governance, and operational quality assurance processes.
* Managed Services \& Service Offering Development
* Design and scale enterprise Data \& AI managed services offerings covering platform operations, application support, DataOps, MLOps, and AI operations.
* Develop reusable operational frameworks, governance standards, support models, delivery playbooks, and service catalogs.
* Define L1/L2/L3 support operating models, escalation procedures, SLA structures, and operational KPIs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality, operational maturity, and delivery efficiency.
* Program Management \& Delivery Governance
* Lead delivery execution across multiple Data \& AI workstreams including data engineering, analytics, governance, AI enablement, and operational support.
* Monitor delivery progress, operational risks, issues, dependencies, and readiness activities across all programs.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, governance policies, cybersecurity requirements, and operational controls.
* Govern delivery reporting, performance tracking, financial oversight, and operational accountability.
* Stakeholder Leadership \& Client Engagement
* Act as the senior onsite engagement lead for Data \& AI programs and operations.
* Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, sector leadership, technical teams, and implementation partners.
* Lead executive governance forums, steering committees, operational reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
* Drive alignment across business, architecture, operations, AI, infrastructure, and governance stakeholders.
* Vendor \& Multi\-Partner Governance
* Govern multi\-vendor delivery and operational coordination across implementation partners, cloud providers, platform vendors, and support teams.
* Manage dependencies, escalation management, operational coordination, and delivery alignment across all involved parties.
* Capability Building, Staffing \& People Management
* Define the long\-term capability model required for sustainable enterprise Data \& AI operations.
* Lead workforce planning, staffing strategy, onboarding, capability development, and succession planning.
* Support recruitment and management of Data \& AI delivery, operations, governance, engineering, AI, PMO, and support resources.
* Coach and mentor teams to establish high\-performance delivery and operational practices.
* Business Growth \& Commercial Support
* Identify service expansion and upsell opportunities aligned with client strategic priorities.
* Support development of proposals, business cases, effort estimates, pricing models, and service expansion strategies.
* Manage delivery financials including forecasting, utilization tracking, operational efficiency, and margin optimization.
* Communication \& Executive Reporting
* Provide executive\-level dashboards, operational updates, release readiness reports, risk registers, and performance reporting.
* Lead communication planning and change management activities supporting operational adoption and stakeholder engagement.


**Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in enterprise Data \& AI delivery, platform operations, managed services, or digital transformation programs.
* Proven experience leading enterprise scale DataOps, MLOps, AI operations, or Data \& AI platform support organizations.
* Experience managing production critical enterprise platforms and large scale release programs.
* Experience establishing managed services, operational governance models, and scalable support capabilities from inception.
* Experience managing executive stakeholder relationships within government or large enterprise environments is highly preferred.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of DataOps, MLOps, CI/CD, enterprise data platforms, data architecture, data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, and analytics ecosystems.
* Experience operationalizing enterprise AI use cases in production environments.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML operationalization including model deployment, monitoring, retraining cycles, drift detection, inference operations, and AI governance controls.
* Familiarity with operational processes including testing governance, deployment pipelines, incident management, problem management, and service operations.


**Leadership \& Management Competencies**
* Excellent executive stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi\-disciplinary teams across delivery, operations, AI, engineering, governance, and support functions.
* Strong strategic thinking and operational leadership capabilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in complex, multi\-stakeholder, and multi\-vendor environments.


**Mandatory Requirements**

**Job Description**
 Parsons is seeking an Assistant Project Manager to support the end‑to‑end delivery of a large‑scale Geospatial Digital Twin programme for a major national infrastructure owner in the Middle East. This multi‑year initiative will design, build, and operationalize a Digital Twin platform that integrates geospatial data, real‑time IoT/SCADA feeds, asset information, and core enterprise systems to enable data‑driven planning, operations, and maintenance. The role will work closely with the Project Manager and a team of international experts, developers, and engineers.
   

  

 The scope spans discovery and stakeholder engagement, requirements and architecture design, proof‑of‑concept delivery, implementation of a production‑grade environment, post‑implementation support, and structured training and knowledge transfer. The Assistant Project Manager will help coordinate cross‑functional teams and vendors, support stakeholder management activities, contribute to project planning and reporting, and assist in driving successful delivery against time, budget, quality, and benefits targets.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Support the Project Manager in delivering the Geospatial Digital Twin programme across discovery, design, PoC, implementation, and post‑implementation support phases
* Assist in planning and tracking scope, schedule, budget, risks, and issues, and in preparing related project reports and documentation
* Help coordinate activities of the international project team (consultants, solution architects, data engineers, developers, GIS/IoT specialists, trainers) and external vendors
* Support stakeholder engagement across multiple client entities, including helping to organise workshops, capture requirements, and document decisions and actions
* Assist in coordinating the development of functional and non‑functional requirements, solution and data architecture artefacts, and integration designs for the Digital Twin platform
* Support the setup and execution of the Proof of Concept by tracking tasks, dependencies, and validation activities for key use cases and data flows
* Assist in planning and tracking the transition from PoC to a production‑grade environment, including platform build, integrations, testing, and go‑live readiness
* Support the organisation and tracking of post‑implementation support activities, including warranty services, incident and problem management, and minor enhancements
* Assist in planning and coordinating training and knowledge transfer activities, and in collating feedback to improve client adoption
* Prepare draft status reports, presentations, and other project communications for review by the Project Manager and presentation to Parsons and client stakeholders


**What Required Skills You'll Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree/ Technical degree from an accredited program involving technology, engineering, GIS, or digital solutions
* Having 8 years of experience supporting large‑scale digital, Digital Twin, or geospatial projects in an infrastructure, utilities, or urban environment
* Working knowledge of the Esri ArcGIS platform and software (e.g., ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, web maps/apps)
* Exposure to solutions that integrate ArcGIS with enterprise and operational systems (e.g., CMMS/EAM, ERP, BIM, SCADA/IoT platforms, data warehouses/lakes)
* Basic understanding of systems integration concepts and technologies (APIs, web services, message queues, event‑driven architectures)
* Familiarity with data and information architecture concepts, particularly geospatial, time‑series, and asset/linear network data
* Awareness of building data models for analysis or simulation is an advantage
* Experience working within multidisciplinary, multinational teams across multiple time zones
* Strong organisational and coordination skills, with some experience in project planning and control (scope, schedule, risks, issues), preferably using formal methodologies (e.g., PMI, PRINCE2, Agile/Hybrid)
* Exposure to testing, acceptance, or go‑live activities for complex or integrated systems
* Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical information to non‑technical stakeholders
* Fluency in both spoken and written English and Arabic is required


**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**
* Prior work with national infrastructure owners, transport, utilities, or public works organisations
* Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS) and modern DevOps practices
* Professional certifications in project management or GIS (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Esri certifications)


 Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.
   

  

 We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY!

data.jd_text:
**Data Centre, Technical \& Engineering Director** 




**Doha, Qatar** 




  





  






 Position Overview:
 




  





 The Technical \& Engineering Director position will be working within the businesses EPC Power \& Digital division, on all MENA data centre project.
 



  





 The role is responsible for the end\-to\-end technical integrity of data centre projects from front\-end definition through to construction handover, ensuring that power, cooling, civil, and ICT systems are designed to hyperscale and colocation standards and are fully constructable and operable at commissioning.
 



  





 Working in close alignment with the EPC Chief Operations Officer the Technical \& Engineering Director serves as the day\-to\-day technical authority on assigned projects, owning design standards, discipline coordination, OEM interfaces, and technical risk management across the full delivery lifecycle.
 



  





 Some travel to construction sites across MENA will be required when necessary.
 



  






 Key Responsibilities:
 




  




* Lead multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across power, cooling, civil/structural, and ICT disciplines
* Own technical standards and design basis documentation through to FEED
* Ensure all designs are constructable, installation logic aligned, and ready for site execution
* Manage inter discipline coordination and clash resolution using 3D plant modelling tools (REVIT, etc.)
* Oversee HV/MV/LV power architecture design including utility intake, MV switchgear, transformers, and LV distribution
* Manage UPS, battery storage, and generator system design and OEM interfaces
* Ensure power redundancy models are correctly implemented, targeting AI\-ready campuses
* Coordinate protection, metering, and power quality studies with specialist consultants
* Lead cooling system design including air\-side economization, chillers, air cooling, and liquid cooling for high\-density AI compute
* Target PUE benchmarks in line with hyperscale client requirements; industry benchmark for AI campuses is 1\.2–1\.4 PUE
* Oversee plumbing, drainage, HVAC, and fire suppression system design and integration
* Interface with energy modelling teams to validate system performance and efficiency projections
* Manage civil and structural design scope including foundations, raised floor systems, data halls, and façade
* Ensure structural designs accommodate equipment loadings, seismic considerations, and phased capacity expansion
* Oversee M\&E services coordination within building fabric to eliminate site clashes and rework
* Oversee ICT infrastructure design including structured cabling, fiber backbone, and carrier\-neutral meet\-me rooms
* Ensure DCIM\-readiness is embedded in design from the outset to support operational efficiency post\-handover
* Coordinate with network operators and hyperscale clients on connectivity and meet\-me room requirements
* Engage the commissioning team from FEED stage to ensure testability and safe energization sequences are designed in
* Define and review CX documentation including CX plans, ITPs, FAT and SAT procedures
* Ensure technical handover packages are complete, accurate, and meet client O\&M requirements
* Embed safety by design principles across all engineering disciplines
* Own HAZOP/HAZID planning and chairing, ensuring action close\-out is tracked
* Manage quality assurance processes for design deliverables including review gates, checking, and sign\-off
* Act as primary technical interface with hyperscale and colocation clients during design development
* Lead technical clarification meetings with clients, authorities, and utility providers



  






 Qualifications \& Experience
 




  




* Degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline (BEng / MEng)
* 10\+ years of engineering experience in mission\-critical facilities or data centre projects
* Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or large\-scale colocation data centre projects
* Deep working knowledge of data centre power architecture
* Strong cooling systems experience
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary design teams of 10\+ engineers
* Experience with FEL/FEED\-driven delivery models
* Proficiency in design tools including AutoCAD, REVIT, or equivalent
* Working experience in the Middle East or comparable international markets
* LEED, BREEAM, or equivalent sustainability certification experience
* Familiarity with hyperscale client design standards (Google, Microsoft Azure, Meta, AWS, Oracle)



  





 This is a full time, 5 days\-a\-week head office position in Doha, Qatar.

data.jd_text:
The operations Coordinator supports the establishment and continuous maintenance of a system\-driven operating platform across Property \& Facility Management.
 



 The role is responsible for building and controlling structured reporting systems, centralized repositories, performance dashboards, governance trackers, and financial visibility tools that enable disciplined execution across the department.
 



 The position creates and manages a centralized digital control environment where data integrity, live reporting, documentation governance, and cross\-functional coordination are maintained under structured access and version control.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**1\.Performance Management \& Dashboard Architecture:**




**Establish and maintain a live, structured performance management system across the department:** 



* Design, build, and maintain Excel\-based operational dashboards integrated with Power BI where required.
* Convert departmental KPIs into measurable, live, and automated tracking systems.
* Maintain automated performance trackers with controlled access and minimal manual input.
* Develop standardized reporting packs for weekly and monthly management review.
* Ensure reporting accuracy, version control, and structured update cadence.



**Outcome Focus:** 
 Real\-time management visibility and automated performance tracking.
 



  





**2\.Data Governance \& Central Repository Control**




**Establish and control a centralized digital repository and data structure across the department** 



* Create and manage structured central repository for reports, SOPs, contracts, and trackers
* Implement controlled\-access structure where data input is permitted but structural edits are restricted
* Integrate reporting outputs from ERP and CAFM into centralized reporting dashboards
* Maintain automated reporting templates and structured folder governance
* Ensure data integrity, structured storage, and retrieval discipline



**Outcome Focus:** 
 Controlled, secure, and reliable information ecosystem.
 



  





**3\.Process Design \& Governance Implementation**




**Translate strategy into documented processes and structured execution models.** 



* Develop process maps, workflows, and escalation matrices using structured tools (e.g., Visio or equivalent)
* Assist in drafting, organizing, and maintaining SOPs across property and facility functions
* Establish decision\-rights documentation and reporting hierarchies
* Monitor compliance with defined processes and governance frameworks
* Optimize and refine operational workflows continuously.



**Outcome Focus:** 
 Clearly defined, documented, and enforceable operating processes.
 



  






 4\.
 
**Financial \& Operational Visibility Systems**




**Create structured financial and operational reporting frameworks.** 



* Develop and maintain cost tracking and budget monitoring systems.
* Coordinate structured financial reporting with Finance and Procurement.
* Maintain OPEX tracking dashboards and variance reporting models.
* Support PNL visibility across assets through live reporting systems.
* Ensure financial data integration into performance dashboards.



**Outcome Focus:** 
 Transparent, structured financial control and reporting.
 



  





**5\. Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Departmental Administration.**




**Ensure structured coordination and execution across the department** 




  




* Maintain departmental action trackers and initiative follow\-up logs.
* Coordinate reporting inputs across FM, Property, Leasing, Finance, and Procurement.
* Organize structured departmental meetings and documentation of outputs.
* Monitor progress against roadmap milestones and strategic initiatives.

 General Management \& Business Operations

**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of executing service orders for the compression fleet, driving meaningful projects that enhance operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Your role will involve strategic planning and coordination, ensuring that projects are delivered within scope, time, quality, and budget, thereby contributing significantly to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a dynamic team environment that values collaboration, innovation, and proactive communication, fostering a culture of growth and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Execute compression service orders, including parts, repairs, field service, and complete outage projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Manage customer relationships during order execution, acting as their advocate within the organization and enhancing communication across service offerings.
* Organize and lead teams, define responsibilities, develop schedules, and allocate resources to address specific project challenges effectively.
* Extend service order management to the Middle Eastern region as needed, ensuring seamless execution and delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to achieve revenue, EBIT, on\-time delivery, and project delivery targets, while driving client satisfaction and supporting cash collection.
* Collaborate with finance for accurate forecasting and coordinate with global teams to align service order execution with global standards.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, or a related field, with 4\-6 years of relevant experience in project management, preferably in the Oil \& Gas industry or with rotating equipment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to develop and implement strategic plans effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with project management and order management tools and concepts.
* Self\-driven and adaptable, with a positive attitude and the ability to solve challenges collaboratively.
* Familiarity with CRM (Salesforce) and ERP software (e.g., SAP) is highly desirable, enhancing operational efficiency.
* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills, with strong leadership abilities to influence stakeholders and drive project success.


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

 The IT Project Management function is still relatively new, so this is also an opportunity to contribute to how projects are managed across the organisation moving forward.

 • Strong communication and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Good understanding of Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
 



 • Experience with project management tools such as Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or similar.
 



 • Comfortable working across both applications and infrastructure\-related projects.
 



 • Experience working with integrations, APIs, migrations, SaaS platforms, or digital transformation initiatives is beneficial.
 



 • Background within insurance, banking, telecoms, MSPs, or other regulated/service\-led environments would be advantageous.

 • Arabic fluency would be a ideal.

 • Opportunity to join a business actively investing in digital transformation

 • A chance to help shape and improve delivery processes within a growing PMO function

 • A collaborative environment with strong leadership support for improving project delivery

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

 At Worley, we’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and can thrive is essential to our mission of delivering sustainable change. We know that diverse and inclusive cultures are safer and more innovative.
   

  

 We encourage applications from candidates from all backgrounds and diversity characteristics and warmly encourage disabled or neuro divergent candidates to apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Planning \& Scheduling**
* Develop and maintain integrated project schedules using tools such as Primavera P6\.
* Ensure alignment with Saudi Aramco scheduling standards and milestones.
* Monitor schedule performance and identify critical path impacts.


**Cost Control \& Budgeting**
* Establish project budgets, cost breakdown structures (CBS), and control baselines.
* Monitor project expenditures, commitments, and forecasts.
* Perform variance analysis and recommend corrective actions.


**Progress Measurement \& Reporting**
* Develop and implement progress measurement systems.
* Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports for Worley and Saudi Aramco stakeholders.
* Track KPIs and ensure accurate project performance visibility.


**Risk \& Change Management**
* Lead risk identification, analysis, and mitigation planning.
* Manage change control processes in line with Saudi Aramco procedures.
* Evaluate cost and schedule impacts of changes and variations.


**Project Controls Systems \& Governance**
* Implement project controls procedures, tools, and systems.
* Ensure compliance with Worley and Saudi Aramco project control frameworks.
* Conduct audits and reviews of project controls practices.


**Stakeholder Coordination**
* Interface with engineering, procurement, construction, and client teams.
* Participate in client meetings and presentations.
* Provide strategic insights to support decision\-making.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and mentor project controls team (planners, cost engineers, risk analysts).
* Allocate resources and oversee team performance.
* Promote continuous improvement and best practices.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
* Experienced in project controls within oil \& gas, EPC, or energy sectors.
* Proven experience on Saudi Aramco projects is highly preferred.
* Strong expertise in Primavera P6, cost control systems, and reporting tools.
* In\-depth knowledge of EPC project lifecycle and large\-scale capital projects.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

* Acts as a primary day to day liaison to the client project leadership teams and project execution partners.
* Identifies and resolve disputes quickly and reasonably with Project Stakeholders.
* Develops and maintains a comprehensive project plan, in keeping with the size and complexity as mutually agreed upon by the JEG organization SOP and the Project Director.

Ensure regular audits are carried out for EHS compliance and any remedial actions are implemented in coordination with the HSE Manager.

**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Time served apprenticeship an advantage.
* Minimum 10 years work experience on construction projects / Minimum 3 years as a Project Manager
* Qualifications commensurate with position:
* Role applicable degree from a reputed university / Trade Qualifications NVQ, etc.
* Experience in Data Centre Projects.
* Competent in the use of PC applications (Microsoft Office suit or equivalent)
* Civil/ CSA experience

 The Senior Project Manager Implements ES\&H and Quality programs whilst maintaining effective relationships when interfacing with stakeholders.

**Major Responsibilities:** 



* Responsible for ECEC’s activities regarding the delivery of the assigned scope of works, maintaining the highest standards concerning safety, quality, progress, and the performance of the works
* Managing the teams, subcontractors, and third parties to ensure the delivery of the works
* Lead the project team at the assigned area of works

* Lead the ES\&H implementation activities, conduct joint safety inspections with the Contractor’s senior staff, and participate in the clients' ES\&H programs
* Implement project quality management plans, ensure contractors' compliance with project quality requirements, and the works are executed as per IFC drawings, standards, codes, and project specifications

* Manage all aspects of the project scope from design constructability, design interfaces, and execution of the works

**Education and Experience Requirements:** 



* A recognized bachelor’s or master’s degree in architecture or civil / Structural Engineering is preferred
* Minimum 20 years of professional experience, or 25 years of total experience

data.jd_text:
**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**Qualifications and Skills**



* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

data.jd_text:
**Be Part of a Legacy Bigger Than the Game** 




  





 At Al\-Qadsiah Club we’re creating more than teams—we’re crafting a legacy that goes beyond the game, making an impact both on and off the field. Driven by ambition, synergy, and innovation, we aim to inspire generations while shaping the future of Saudi sports.
 



  





 This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to be part of something larger than yourself. At Al\-Qadsiah, you’ll play a key role in shaping our legacy, contributing to the nation’s sports vision, and making history every step of the way.
 



  





**Overview:** 




  





 As the Academy Head of Medical Services at Al\-Qadsiah Club, you will lead the delivery of medical care across the Academy. You will ensure the highest standards of player health, wellbeing, and safeguarding, while providing expert medical guidance to players and staff. You will oversee medical operations, drive best practice, and align all medical provision with the club’s performance objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Leadership and Management** 




  





 Lead the delivery of all Academy medical services in collaboration with the Academy Technical Director and Head of Medical Services
 



 Develop and implement an Academy Medical Framework, ensuring player health, wellbeing, and safeguarding
 



 Oversee medical department operations, including clinic management, equipment, and supplies
 



 Design and supervise the work of all Academy medical staff, providing guidance and leadership
 



 Establish and refine medical processes, reporting structures, and communication systems
 



  





**Medical Assessments and Interventions** 




  





 Assess, diagnose, and manage musculoskeletal injuries and health\-related conditions affecting Academy players
 



 Interpret medical imaging including X\-rays, CT scans, and MRI to support clinical decisions
 



 Deliver medical screenings and ongoing health assessments for all Academy players
 



 Provide immediate medical care during training and matches
 



 Develop and implement injury prevention strategies and protocols
 



 Coordinate hospital referrals and ensure appropriate medical interventions
 



  





**Collaboration** 




  





 Work closely with Academy and club departments to maintain a safe and high\-performance environment
 



 Communicate effectively with players and their families on medical matters
 



 Act as a key liaison with external medical professionals and specialists
 



  





**Operational and Professional Standards** 




  





 Support Heads of Department on internal matters where required
 



 Ensure all medical staff meet CPD requirements and maintain professional standards
 



 Deliver additional responsibilities as required by senior leadership
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Desirable:** 




 Master’s degree in Sports Science, Medicine, or a related field
 



 PhD in Sports Science, Medicine, or a related field
 



 Specialisation in areas such as rehabilitation, orthopaedics, sports science, physiotherapy, radiology, or biomechanics
 



  





  





**Skills, Knowledge and Experience** 
 :
 



  





**Essential** 
 :
 



 Extensive experience in a medical role within a professional sports environment, ideally football
 



 Strong background in diagnosing, treating, and preventing sports\-related injuries
 



 Experience leading and managing multidisciplinary medical teams
 



 Expertise in rehabilitation and return\-to\-play protocols
 



 Experience working with elite athletes and understanding the demands of professional football
 



 Proven ability to work collaboratively across departments
 



 Formal training and experience in diagnostic procedures, including ultrasound\-guided techniques
 



  





**Desirable** 
 :
 



 Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the Middle East

 Celeros Flow Technology is looking for individuals with a voice and a vision. We embrace change, diversity and promote new ways of looking at old ideas. We seek talented professionals to join our world\-class team of innovators in a global, collaborative \& multi\-cultural environment, where you will be challenged, supported, and inspired to be extraordinary.
   

  

**General Summary**
 The Job Holder will be responsible for the sales and business development of the of assigned brands/ products/ services, to key Power \& Energy End Users, within Saudi Arabia and Bahrain:
   

  

* 
+ Assigned Products Valves: Copes\-Vulcan and M\&J Valves
+ Assigned Products Closures: GD Engineering
+ Assigned Territory KSA \& Bahrain


 The Job Holder will proactively interact with new and existing customers to expand the customer base, develop the customer relationship, troubleshoot the specific customer concerns or problems, generate leads and opportunities, all with the objective to achieve the specified sales and business development targets. The Job Holder will also prepare and present sales presentations, sales forecasts and action plans in order to maximise the market potential and will develop goals accordingly to achieve the specified sales and business development targets.
   

  

**Principal Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Sell and promote Celeros Flow Technology assigned aftermarket on spares, upgrades and service solutions in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain (End users, service contractors, engineering consultants) or via Local Agents / Distributors (where applicable).
* Where Local Agents / Distributors are necessary it will be required to ensure the appropriate procedures are followed and the required support is provided to facilitate the deal. When engaging with a new Local Agent / Distributor ensure the due diligence documents should be completed and submitted in a timely manner to the Legal Department for approval. Continue to manage and support the Local Agents / Distributors – provide technical and commercial support, provide training and guidance, make joint visits to key Customers as necessary, set KPI’s, monitor and evaluate performance, provide feedback / escalate as necessary through weekly meetings and quarterly reviews.
* Demonstrate strong expertise for assigned products and for the industry.
* Develop and expand relationships with existing and potential Customers and maintain close relationships with key Customers through driving spares price agreements with key accounts.
* Communicate regularly and consistently with existing and potential Customers to generate leads and opportunities and maximize aftermarket entitlement of the installed base.
* Appraise Customer’s current and future needs and advise on the appropriate Celeros Flow Technology products and services to meet their requirements and propose alternative solutions as necessary.
* Follow up with Customers to ensure Celeros Flow Technology products and services are meeting their requirements and expectations.
* Investigate and coordinate the resolution of complaints raised by Customers and troubleshoot their concerns.
* Interface with Customers and conduct on\-site meetings as necessary to understand requirements, to obtain order commitment, to finalise designs and to resolve concerns / complaints.
* Collaborate with other Regional Product Sales Managers, sharing information and business opportunities.
* Coordinate with Field Service Engineers to win Customer maintenance contracts where appropriate.
* Support Field Service Engineers and conduct joint site visits to facilitate work and training activities.
* Proactively react to Customers RFQ’s (request for quotation). secure the necessary internal approval to proceed with a quotation. Effectively communicates to the Customer the intention to provide a quotation, or not. Updates the CRM or equivalent tool accordingly.
* In close consultation with the Application Engineering Team and where necessary the Product Management Team, review and interpret Customer enquiries. Analyze the requirements in line with data sheets, specifications, P\&IDs, plans, and other project specific documents. Design, size and select suitable products as per the Customers requirements and support the Application Engineering Team to develop an appropriate proposal / quotation.
* For both the Company and the Customer coordinate the technical and commercial review of the quotation and assist with the negotiations for the same.
* Once quotation negotiations have concluded, prior to receiving the Customers PO, secure the necessary approval as per Company established approval matrix for all orders above Company defined threshold limit and for all orders that stipulate exceptional T\&C’s.
* Organise and drive the preparation of bids and contracts.
* Coordinate with the Finance / Accounts team and be aware of and problems with Supplier and Customer accounts.
* Coordinate and actively participate in the order hand over meeting with the Manufacturing Facility, Project Manager and Supply Chain Team. Provide clarification on any specific project requirements and on any technical or commercial queries.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, review the market potential for assigned products in the assigned territories and compile a strategy and action plan in order to maximize market potential and achieve targets. Continue to develop and recommend innovative ideas and tactics to increase market share and increase sales.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, evaluate and determine optimum route to market, including a pricing and marketing strategy and identify suitable partnership Companies to sell Celeros Flow Technology products and services.
* Execute agreed action plans to achieve targets for assigned products in the assigned territories.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity in the assigned region on a regular basis. Report any concerns and suggested solutions and any opportunities and suggested action plans to the Line Manager / Regional Director.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports (forecast, customer visit report, etc.) showing sales volume including potential sales, monitored against the budget, with action plans to address variations.
* Prepare and deliver sales presentations and technical presentations to internal and external stakeholders.
* Participate in trade shows, exhibitions and seminars either directly or in conjunction with Local Agents / Distributors.
* Represent the Company in a professional manner aligned to the Celeros Flow Technology Values and ensure all activities comply with both legal and ethical standards.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Thinks both creatively and commercially; has in\-depth engineering knowledge to identify technical risks, solve problems and provide solutions but also has in\-depth commercial knowledge to identify risks within contracts.
* Analyses and interprets common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Must be able to define the problem, assess the risks, and develop recommendations for action plans. Furthermore, must be able to execute the action plan, focus and guide others to accomplish the plan and drive change where necessary.
* Encourages others to seek opportunities for different and innovative approaches to addressing problems and opportunities; facilitates the implementation and acceptance of change within the workplace.
* Displays exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, even when handling multiple demands and has a proven track record of meeting high performance standards.
* Responds professionally to all inquiries and complaints and remains calm and composed when under pressure.
* Communicates effectively, effortlessly tailoring the approach to the audience and the level of technical competence.
* Possesses the ability to prepare and deliver both sales and technical presentations and to train and transfer technical knowledge to internal and external stakeholders.
* Clearly and succinctly conveying information and ideas to individuals and groups in a variety of situations; communicating in a focused and compelling way that drives others’ thoughts and actions. Engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.
* Uses appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance of ideas and plans; modifying one’s own behaviour to accommodate tasks, situations, and individuals involved.
* Exhibits confidence with negotiations and possesses the power to influence.
* Is well organized, structured and methodical.
* Is self\-motivated, works independently with little supervision, positively establishes relationships across multiple locations and copes well with working remotely from the team and other departments.
* Is an effective team player (committed, reliable, responsible, flexible, helpful, supportive, active listener / communicator).
* Communicates fluently (verbal and written) in English \- essential, in Arabic – advantageous

**Education \& Experience**

* Five to ten years’ experience in the oil \& gas / power \& energy market – essential
* Strong understanding of mid\-stream market segment, especially pipeline and tank farm sub\-segment along with Power and Water market. Contacts at Aramco, SABIC, SWCC, SEC plants and sites are desirable.
* A thorough understanding of valves and their related applications – specific knowledge of the slab and expanding gate Control and Bypass valve markets, competition, differentiators would be a distinct advantage.

* Strong knowledge of Microsoft packages including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Project.


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

**CELEROS FLOW TECHNOLOGY VALUES**
 All Celeros divisions are committed to the effective use of the Celeros Values. It is important that all employees understand and utilize these values when performing the duties of his/her position.
   

  

**INTEGRITY:** 
 We work safely and respect our employees, business partners \& environment. We always lead by example.
   

  

**SPEED:** 
 In our mission to bring mission\-critical flow control equipment to the world, energy in our actions \& urgency.
   

  

**ACCOUNTABILITY:**

**PARTNERSHIP:**

**EXCELLENCE:** 
 We are passionate about being the best at engineering, manufacturing \& maintaining mission\-critical equipment. We seek quality \& community improvement in every interaction.
   

  

**QUALITY**
 Quality encompasses all aspects of Celeros’ business, and every employee shares the responsibility to prevent the occurrence of any nonconformity relating to product, process and the quality system. All employees have an obligation to identify and record any such nonconformity, and through designed channels, initiate and recommend solutions.

* Mentor students and monitor student assessment and progress
* Engage with academic staff of the School of Nursing \& Midwifery to enhance education and research capacity within the School
* Employ a collaborative ethos in all aspects of academic practice
* Undertake collaborative research internally and with external stakeholders/partner hospitals that complements and develops the School's academic status and reputation, and contributes to nursing practice and education

* Represent the best interest of RCSI at all times by enhancing the School's reputation in both nursing practice, teaching and research

* Perform such other duties as may be required from time to time.


 Requirements

* Is a registered Adult Nurse and educated to Master's Level.
* Has previous experience in teaching, assessing and managing students in an academic environment.

* Has excellent computer, library searching, presentation and verbal and written communication skills.
* Has personal drive, energy and enthusiasm to deliver and inspire the achievement of excellent results.

* Has experience in supervision of MSc and Doctoral level students.
* Has contributed to the development of specialist nursing practice in terms of education, practice development and research.
* Mentoring and supervising colleagues in Lecturer and Clinical Educator positions.

data.jd_text:
**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 The
 **Tech Lead** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging
 **business objectives** 
 with
 **technical execution**

 **hands\-on engineering** 
 ,
 **architectural leadership** 
 , and
 **team enablement** 
 . A Tech Lead ensures delivery excellence by actively contributing to the codebase, guiding the team technically, and aligning execution with long\-term strategic goals.
   

  

 At Keyrock, the
 **Tech Lead** 
 is a
 **senior technical contributor** 
 who drives the
 **implementation and delivery** 
 of engineering initiatives within their Business Unit. The Tech Lead is accountable for
 **technical execution and delivery quality** 
 , ensuring that systems are built to high standards of reliability, performance, and maintainability.
   

  

 While the
 **Head of Engineering (HoE)** 
 focuses on
 **strategic alignment \-** 
 ensuring that engineering outcomes meet the broader objectives agreed with the
 **Head of Product (HoP) \-** 
 the Tech Lead operates as the
 **executional deputy** 
 , translating those strategic objectives into code, architecture, and delivery outcomes.

* Act as the technical point of accountability for the Service Market Making Business Unit.

* Champion collaboration across teams, ensuring alignment between product, design, QA, and engineering.
* Inspire and develop engineers through mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance, fostering growth and autonomy within the team.


 Key Responsibilities

* Familiarity with GitOps workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployments

* Demonstrated leadership of engineering teams, with a commitment to fostering collaboration, mentorship and continuous professional growth
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, able to partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Quantitative Research and Operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a passion for building scalable, reliable and secure systems
* Deep domain knowledge of finance and trading, particularly within the cryptocurrency sector
* Experience in fast\-paced, dynamic financial or fintech environments is highly desirable


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.

**Job Description**
* Maintenance Execution
* Receive instructions from the Maintenance Unit Head/Manager for assigned maintenance tasks and projects.
* Carry out specific maintenance tasks related to machine repairs, new machine commissioning, and validation activities.
* Assist the maintenance team in troubleshooting breakdowns and performing preventive maintenance (PM) as required.
* Prepare designs for specific machine upgrades (electrical or mechanical) and submit them for management review and approval.
* Follow up on project execution after design approval.
* Clean and organize the working area upon task completion.
* Document task details, including timing, completion status, and any new observations/findings.
* Submit Repair Request Forms (RRF) for any pending tasks or additional issues found.
* Obtain feedback from production teams to ensure full resolution and satisfaction.
* Coordination \& Spare Parts Management
* Coordinate with the Maintenance Unit Head/Manager to ensure proper resource allocation for assigned projects.
* Coordinate with the Store regarding delivery of critical spare parts and escalate any delays.
* Prepare and submit Spare Parts Requisition Forms as needed.
* Data Analysis \& Improvement
* Analyze maintenance data, including repetitive breakdowns, delays in PM, and spare part consumption.
* Propose action plans and improvements based on analysis findings.
* Calibration \& External Services
* Execute in\-house calibration tasks as per instructions and defined Work Instructions (WI).
* Coordinate outsourced calibration activities with the Local Purchasing Unit (LPC).
* Ensure timely availability of external calibration agencies, oversee tasks, and follow up on calibration certificates.
* Update the Calibration Master File upon completion.
* Safety \& 5S Compliance
* Follow all NAPCO\-IFP safety procedures and attend all required safety meetings.
* Enforce company health and safety policies among the team and monitor for compliance.
* Carry out risk assessments and ensure emergency response protocols are understood by all personnel.
* Immediately report and act upon unsafe acts, conditions, or near\-misses.
* Participate in cross\-auditing and ensure adherence to the plant’s hazard control standards.
* Conduct daily safety talks in assigned work areas.
* Perform assigned 5S duties as per the 5S plan to maintain an efficient and safe work environment.
* Safety Responsibilities
* Enforce full compliance with health and safety procedures across the maintenance area.
* Understand and ensure all subordinates are trained on safe work practices.
* Identify unsafe conditions or behaviors and take immediate corrective action.
* Lock out any unsafe equipment until it is repaired and deemed safe.
* Actively participate in safety audits, emergency drills, and 5S implementation.
* Promote safety awareness among team members.
* Job Dynamics \& Interfaces


**Internal Interfaces**
* Maintenance Team
* Production Team
* Store \& Spare Parts Team
* Health \& Safety Department


**External Interfaces**
* Local Purchasing Unit (LPC)
* External Calibration Agencies

**Education \& Experience**

**Competencies**

data.jd_text:
**Objective:**
 RCSI Bahrain is seeking to appoint a dynamic and clinically focused Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in Clinical Microbiology to support the delivery of undergraduate and postgraduate medical education within the School of Medicine.
   

  

 Given the clinically integrated nature of the curriculum, the University is specifically seeking a medically qualified clinician with expertise in Infectious Diseases and/or Clinical (Medical) Microbiology. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering clinically relevant microbiology teaching aligned to modern medical practice, patient safety, antimicrobial stewardship, infection prevention, and clinical decision\-making.
   

  

 The appointee will contribute to teaching, assessment, curriculum development, academic advising, and scholarly activity, while supporting the continued integration of microbiology across systems\-based and case\-based learning. The appointee will collaborate closely with the Department of Clinical Microbiology in RCSI Dublin, including participation in teaching and assessment meetings to ensure a coordinated and standardised approach to teaching and assessment across both campuses.
   

  

 Appointment may be made at Lecturer or Senior Lecturer level depending on qualifications, experience, academic profile, and leadership contribution.
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Department of Medicine or Nominee
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Teaching:**
 • Deliver high\-quality teaching in microbiology, infectious diseases, infection prevention, and antimicrobial stewardship across undergraduate programmes.
   

 • Contribute to integrated and clinically contextualised teaching within systems\-based and case\-based curricula.
   

 • Facilitate small\-group teaching, tutorials, laboratory interpretation sessions, clinical correlation sessions, and team\-based learning activities.
   

 • Support the development and delivery of clinically relevant microbiology practical and simulation activities.
   

 • Contribute to online and blended learning initiatives using the University’s digital learning platforms.
   

 • Participate in student assessment activities including question writing, OSCEs, practical examinations, standard setting, and moderation processes.
   

 • Participate in teaching and assessment meeting with the Dept of Clinical Microbiology, RCSI, Dublin
   

 • Provide academic mentorship and pastoral support to students.
   

 • Work collaboratively with clinical and basic science colleagues to ensure relevance and consistency of teaching delivery.
   

 • Contribute to curriculum planning, vertical integration, sequencing, and alignment of microbiology and infectious diseases teaching across the undergraduate programme.
   

 • Work collaboratively across disciplines including medicine, pathology, pharmacology, immunology, paediatrics, and public health to support integrated curriculum delivery.
   

 • Support clinically relevant microbiology practical teaching, simulation activities aligned to clinical practice.
   

  

**Research and Scholarship**
 • Contribute to scholarly activity, educational innovation, research, and/or clinical academic initiatives relevant to microbiology or infectious diseases.
   

 • Support student research, audits, quality improvement initiatives, and scholarly dissemination.
   

 • Develop collaborative links with clinical partners and healthcare institutions within Bahrain and wider region.
   

  

**Student Mentoring:**
 • Provide pastoral care, mentorship, and support in developing research projects to students
   

 • Participate in the Personal Tutor Program to support student well\-being and academic development.
   

  

**General:**
 • Participate in School and University committees, working groups, and academic governance activities.
   

 • Support quality assurance, accreditation, and regulatory activities as required.
   

 • Contribute to outreach, student recruitment, and community engagement initiatives.
   

 • Undertake additional duties appropriate to the grade of appointment.
   

 • Attend administrative and academic meetings relevant to clinical teaching.
   

 • Provide regular feedback to the Head of Department on program content and curriculum development and assist in implementing improvements where appropriate
   

 • Ensure that all RCSI Bahrain policies and procedures are adhered to
   

 • Participate in faculty development and medical education training activities as required.
   

 • Familiarises oneself with the RCSI Bahrain Virtual Learning Environment (VLE)
   

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

**Personal Specifications:** 
  

  

 • Medical degree recognised for clinical practice.
   

 • Specialist qualification and/or board certification and/or FRCPath or equivalent in:
   

  

 o Infectious Diseases, and/or
   

 o Medical Microbiology, and/or
   

 o Clinical Microbiology.
   

  

 • Eligibility for professional registration/licensure in the Kingdom of Bahrain.
   

 • Experience delivering clinical microbiology / infectious diseases teaching.
   

 • Experience in assessment design, moderation, and standard setting.
   

 • Experience with case\-based or blended learning approaches.
   

 • Postgraduate qualification in medical education or ongoing faculty development activity is desirable.
   

 • Ability to deliver high\-quality teaching and educational activities within required timelines.
   

 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
   

 • Ability to demonstrate initiative
   

 • Strong organisational and administrative skills
